text.title: 冰川外衣
text.objectives: 东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的铁匠维尔海姆需要你带给他8个冰冻符文，8份符文布卷，6个水之精华，4份铁网蛛丝，还有300金。同时你必须在银色黎明达到崇拜声望值，才能完成这项任务。
text.description: 谢谢你与欧玛利安，愿他安息。我现在能制作冰川外衣了，你只需要替我找来制作材料，以及支付一些工匠费就可以了。
text.progress: 你有带材料来吗?
text.completion: 这是你要求的东西，$N。依约抵达!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Craftsman Wilhelm at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Glacial Vest
english.objectives: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 8 Frozen Runes, 8 Bolts of Runecloth, 6 Essences of Water, 4 Ironweb Spider Silks and 300 gold. You must also be of Exalted reputation with the Argent Dawn.
english.description: Thanks to you and Omarion, may he rest in peace, I am now able to create a Glacial vest. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
english.completed: Return to Craftsman Wilhelm at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 北极护腕
text.objectives: 将4个冰冻符文、12个魔化皮、3个水之精华、3个熟化毛皮和200金币交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的工匠威尔海姆。
text.description: 感谢你和奥玛里恩（愿奥玛里恩就此安息），现在我可以开始制作北极护腕了。你要做的只是为我提供材料，并支付一笔小小的加工费。
text.progress: 你有带材料来吗?
text.completion: 这是你要求的东西，$N。依约抵达!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Craftsman Wilhelm at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Polar Bracers
english.objectives: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 4 Frozen Runes, 12 Enchanted Leather, 3 Essence of Water, 3 Cured Rugged Hides and 200 gold. $B$B
english.description:
Thanks to you and Omarion (May he rest in peace),

$B I am now able to create Polar bracers. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
english.progress: Have you brought the materials?
english.completion: Here is your order, $N. Delivered as promised!
english.completed: Return to Craftsman Wilhelm at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 北极手套
text.objectives: 将5个冰冻符文、12个魔化皮、3个水之精华、3个熟化毛皮和200金币交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的工匠威尔海姆。
text.description: 感谢你和奥玛里恩（愿奥玛里恩就此安息），现在我可以开始制作北极手套了。你要做的只是为我提供材料，并支付一笔小小的加工费。
text.progress: 你有带材料来吗?
text.completion: 这是你要求的东西，$N。依约抵达!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Craftsman Wilhelm at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Polar Gloves
english.objectives: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Frozen Runes, 12 Enchanted Leather, 3 Essence of Water, 3 Cured Rugged Hides and 200 gold.
english.description:
Thanks to you and Omarion (May he rest in peace),

$B I am now able to create Polar gloves. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
english.completed: Return to Craftsman Wilhelm at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 北极外套
text.objectives: 将8个冰冻符文、16个魔化皮、5个水之精华、5个熟化毛皮和300金币交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的工匠威尔海姆。你在银色黎明的声望必须达到崇拜。
text.description: 感谢你和奥玛里恩（愿奥玛里恩就此安息），现在我可以开始制作北极外套了。你要做的只是为我提供材料，并支付一笔小小的加工费。
text.progress: 你有带材料来吗?
text.completion: 这是你要求的东西，$N。依约抵达!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Craftsman Wilhelm at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Polar Tunic
english.objectives: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 8 Frozen Runes, 16 Enchanted Leathers, 5 Essences of Water, 5 Cured Rugged Hides and 300 gold. You must also be of Exalted reputation with the Argent Dawn.
english.description: Thanks to you and Omarion, may he rest in peace, I am now able to create a Polar tunic. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
english.completed: Return to Craftsman Wilhelm at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 寒鳞护腕
text.objectives: 东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的铁匠维尔海姆需要你带给他4个冰冻符文，16个厚蝎鳞，5个水之精华，3块熟化毛皮，还有200金。
text.description: 谢谢你与欧玛利安，愿他安息。我现在能制作冰鳞护腕了，你只需要替我找来制作材料，以及支付一些工匠费就可以了。
text.progress: 你有带材料来吗?
text.completion: 这是你要求的东西，$N。依约抵达!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Craftsman Wilhelm at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Icy Scale Bracers
english.objectives: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 4 Frozen Runes, 16 Heavy Scorpid Scales, 5 Essences of Water, 3 Cured Rugged Hides and 200 gold.
english.description: Thanks to you and Omarion, may he rest in peace, I am now able to create Icy Scale bracers. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
english.completed: Return to Craftsman Wilhelm at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 寒鳞护手
text.objectives: 东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的铁匠维尔海姆需要你带给他5个冰冻符文，16个厚蝎鳞，5个水之精华 ，3块熟化毛皮，还有200金。
text.description: 谢谢你与欧玛利安，愿他安息。我现在能制作冰鳞护手了，你只需要替我找来制作材料，以及支付一些工匠费就可以了。
text.progress: 你有带材料来吗?
text.completion: 这是你要求的东西，$N。依约抵达!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Craftsman Wilhelm at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Icy Scale Gauntlets
english.objectives: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Frozen Runes, 16 Heavy Scorpid Scale, 5 Essence of Water, 3 Cured Rugged Hides and 200 gold.
english.description:
Thanks to you and Omarion (May he rest in peace),

$B I am now able to create Icy Scale gauntlets. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
english.completed: Return to Craftsman Wilhelm at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 寒鳞胸甲
text.objectives: 东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的铁匠维尔海姆需要你带给他8个冰冻符文，24个厚蝎鳞，7个水之精华 ，5块熟化毛皮，还有300金。同时你必须在银色黎明达到崇拜声望值，才能完成这项任务。
text.description: 谢谢你与欧玛利安，愿他安息。我现在能制作冰鳞胸甲了，你只需要替我找来制作材料，以及支付一些工匠费就可以了。
text.progress: 你有带材料来吗?
text.completion: 这是你要求的东西，$N。依约抵达!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Craftsman Wilhelm at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Icy Scale Breastplate
english.objectives: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 8 Frozen Runes, 24 Heavy Scorpid Scale, 7 Essence of Water, 5 Cured Rugged Hides and 300 gold. You must also be of Exalted reputation with the Argent Dawn.
english.description:
Thanks to you and Omarion (May he rest in peace),

$B I am now able to create an Icy Scale breastplate. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
english.completed: Return to Craftsman Wilhelm at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 保管者的征召
text.objectives: 将名册保管者的信交给在东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的他。
text.description: 魔兽资料库网友，$B长久以来你为了银色黎明的利益服务，永远表现你最有能力的一面。现在，我们又耳闻一项极需支援的号召。$B魔兽资料库网友，若你愿意协助的话，请向东瘟疫之地的圣光之愿礼拜堂，跟名册保管者报到。

english.title: The Keeper's Call
english.objectives: Take the Letter from the Keeper of the Rolls to him at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: $N,$B$BIn times past you have served the interests of the Argent Dawn, always to the best of your abilities. Now, once again, we sound the clarion call in our time of greatest need.$B$B$N, please report to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands if you are willing to aid us once more.

text.title: 谦卑的馈赠
text.objectives: 将一根深渊节杖交给希利苏斯塞纳里奥要塞的奥蕾尔·金叶。你在塞纳里奥议会的声望必须达到尊敬。
text.description: Ishnu-alah，$R。让我看看能证明你杀死深渊议会领主的证据，我就奖励你一件好东西，它能在你与其拉虫人作战时帮你一臂之力。
text.progress: (达纳苏斯语)报上名来?喔，请原谅我，$N。我没有认出你来。你拿到权杖了吗?
text.completion: 安德索拉斯-尔西斯，在我母语里的意思是代表「愿你的烦恼减至最低」。$B$B骄傲地戴上戒指，保佑你健健康康，$N。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Aurel Goldleaf at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: A Humble Offering
english.objectives: Aurel Goldleaf at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to bring her 1 Abyssal Scepter. You must also be Honored with the Cenarion Circle.
english.description: Ishnu-alah, $r. Show me proof of the demise of a Lord of the Abyssal Council and I shall reward you with an item that should aid you in your battles against the Qiraji.
english.progress: Fandu-dath-belore? Oh, pardon me, $n. I did not recognize you. Have you the scepter?
english.completion: Ande'thoras-ethil. It means; 'May your troubles be diminished,' in my native tongue. Wear the band proudly and in good health, $n.
english.completed: Return to Aurel Goldleaf at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 40张奖券 - 高级奖品
text.progress: 靠过来，靠过来!如果你想要兑换暗月马戏团奖券，尽管开口吧!你可以用奖券兑换各种不同面值的神奇又梦幻的奖品。不要害羞了，来试试看吧!
text.completion: 拿去吧，拿去吧!一个最适合$G国王:皇后;的奖品!恭喜你，我的朋友!$B$B如果你有更多奖券想要兑换，请告诉我!只要暗月马戏团还在这里，我就会兑换你的奖券。
text.completed: Return to Gelvas Grimegate.

english.title: 40 Tickets - Schematic: Steam Tonk Controller
english.completion: Here you go, here you go!  A prize fit for a king!  Congratulations to you, my friend! If you have more tickets you'd like to turn in, then please let me know!  For as long as the Darkmoon Faire is here, I'll redeem your tickets.
english.completed: Return to Gelvas Grimegate.

text.title: 埃提耶什的杖柄
text.objectives: 看看有谁能帮你找到法杖的最后两个部分，并且净化邪恶的力量。
text.description: 合成杖柄之后，从形状上来看，守护者的传说之杖埃提耶什只差法杖顶部和杖柄末端两个部分了。还有个小问题就是：这根杖子蕴涵着萨格拉斯的邪恶力量。$B$B看看有谁能帮你找到残余的法杖碎片并且净化那些邪恶的力量。
text.progress: 她的时辰到了，凡人。
text.completion: 大法师已经死了。$B$B别为他们的死而哀伤，$N。这一切都是命。就好像你手握守护者之杖也是命中注定……

english.title: Frame of Atiesh
english.objectives: Find someone that will help you in recovering the last two pieces of the staff and ridding it of evil.
english.description: With the frame formed, Atiesh is nearly whole. Only the head and base of the staff are now missing. There is also a minor issue regarding the staff being a conduit for Sargeras's evil.$B$BFind someone that can assist you in locating the remaining pieces and exorcising the evil from the staff.

text.title: 埃提耶什，被玷污的传说之杖
text.objectives: 塔纳利斯时光之穴的阿纳克洛斯要你找到埃提耶什的法杖顶部和埃提耶什的杖柄末端。
text.description: 你很困惑为何自己还活在世上吧。毕竟，你拥有这么一件邪恶的物品。没有确切的答案，$N。我只是做我应该做的事儿罢了。$B$B克尔苏加德就在纳克萨玛斯宫殿的王座上策划着某个阴谋……他要找的东西在你手中，而你要找的东西在他手中。$B$B一位名叫布莱恩·铜须的矮人曾携带杖柄的末端进入安其拉，却不小心将它遗失在了安其拉里面。$B$B一旦你成功拿到杖柄末端，就立即来找我吧。
text.progress: 以现状来看，法杖落在人类手上实在是太危险了。
text.completion: 里面有一个东西……一个不存在於世界上的东西。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Anachronos at Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

english.title: Atiesh, the Befouled Greatstaff
english.objectives: Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants the Staff Head of Atiesh and the Base of Atiesh.
english.description: You question why you are still alive. After all, you have in your possession an item of great evil. The answer is not clear, $N. I only do as I must.$B$BKel'Thuzad sits atop his throne in Naxxramas, plotting... He seeks that which you hold and holds that which you seek.$B$BAs for the base of the staff; the dwarf, Brann Bronzebeard, held it when he entered Ahn'Qiraj. He has left Ahn'Qiraj but the base of Atiesh remains.$B$BShould you succeed in recovering the pieces, return them to me.
english.completed: Return to Anachronos at Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

text.title: 保卫晴风村
text.objectives: 杀死4个腐肢劫掠者和4个黑暗怨灵，然后向永歌森林晴风村的游侠萨蕾恩复命。
text.description: $N，亡灵天灾的攻击愈发频繁，晴风村薄弱的防御力量已经有些捉襟见肘了，而银月城的援军又迟迟没有消息。死亡之痕里到处都是天灾军团的士兵，去帮我们削减它们的数量吧。
text.completion: Many thanks, $n.  Our job is a thankless one, but today you helped make it a bit easier.
text.completed: Return to Ranger Sareyn at Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.

english.title: Defending Fairbreeze Village
english.objectives: Slay 4 Rotlimb Marauders and 4 Darkwraiths and return to Ranger Sareyn at Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.
english.description: We've experienced a marked increase in Scourge attacks, $N.  Our defenses are barely holding and there's no sign of reinforcements from Silvermoon City.  Lend us a hand in defending the village by thinning the numbers of the undead roaming the Dead Scar nearby.
english.completion: Many thanks, $n.  Our job is a thankless one, but today you helped make it a bit easier.
english.completed: Return to Ranger Sareyn at Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.

text.title: 符文看守者德尔雅
text.objectives: 与永歌森林和幽魂之地交界处的符文看守者德尔雅谈一谈。
text.description: 亡灵天灾的攻击愈发频繁，我怀疑是幽魂之地边界的某块符石出了问题。$B$B这些远古的符石可以抵御天灾士兵的入侵，保护我们的村落。太阳之井遭到攻击时，大多数符石都被摧毁或是遗失了。$B$B沿着南面的道路往幽魂之地的方向前进，拐入道路西边的小径。符文看守者德尔雅就站在符石附近，他会告诉你到底出了什么状况。
text.completion: You must've been sent by someone at Fairbreeze Village.  I knew it would just be a matter of time until help arrived.

english.title: Runewarden Deryan
english.objectives: Speak to Runewarden Deryan in Eversong Woods, near the border with the Ghostlands.
english.description: This increase in Scourge attacks leads me to believe there might be a malfunction at one of the protective runestones at the border with the Ghostlands.$B$BWe used these ancient stones to protect us against the undead.  Most of them were destroyed or lost after the attack on the Sunwell. $B$BFollow the road south, towards the Ghostlands, and look to the west for a small path.  You will find Runewarden Deryan by the runestone nearby; he will know whether anything's wrong.
english.completion: You must've been sent by someone at Fairbreeze Village.  I knew it would just be a matter of time until help arrived.

text.title: 外出的学徒
text.objectives: 与永歌森林东部圣殿的学徒米尔维达谈一谈。
text.description: 谢谢你的帮忙，$N。在我整顿这里的同时，我想请你帮我一个忙。我以前的一个学徒正在死亡之痕中部的东部圣殿进行一项危险的研究。$B$B我担心她的安危，如果你能找到她，就看她是否还活着，然后回来向我报告她的情况。
text.completion: It's so nice of my old mentor to check on me.  It's too bad she lost faith in my research long ago. Don't waste your time trying to get me to return to her; you can either help me with my research or leave.

english.title: The Wayward Apprentice
english.objectives: Speak to Apprentice Mirveda at the East Sanctum in Eversong Woods.
english.description: Thank you for your help, $N.  While I get things back in order here, I'd like to ask you for a favor.  One of my former apprentices embarked in a very dangerous line of research.  She journeyed to the East Sanctum, in the middle of the Dead Scar.$B$BI worry for her well-being.  See if you can find her and convince her to return to her senses.
english.completion: It's so nice of my old mentor to check on me.  It's too bad she lost faith in my research long ago. Don't waste your time trying to get me to return to her; you can either help me with my research or leave.

text.title: 研究笔记
text.objectives: 将研究笔记交给永歌森林晴风村的魔导师兰德拉·晨行者。
text.description: 虽然研究结果令人气馁，但是我在研究笔记中记录的数据还是很有价值的。我想听听导师对这些数据的意见。到西边的晴风村去，把笔记交给魔导师兰德拉·晨行者。
text.progress: 你有东西要给我吗?
text.completion: These notes... are shocking.  If they're correct it means the damage to the land on the Dead Scar is irreversible. I'll notify the grand magister right away.  More reason for our race to escape this world and find our true fate in Outland.

english.title: Research Notes
english.objectives: Deliver the Research Notes to Magistrix Landra Dawnstrider at Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.
english.description: As discouraging as my research results are, they still contain valuable data.  I must have a magister review my work before it is taken seriously.  Please, take these notes to Magistrix Landra Dawnstrider at Fairbreeze Village, west of here.
english.progress: You've something for me?
english.completion: These notes... are shocking.  If they're correct it means the damage to the land on the Dead Scar is irreversible. I'll notify the grand magister right away.  More reason for our race to escape this world and find our true fate in Outland.

text.title: 晴风村
text.objectives: 与永歌森林晴风村的游侠戴戈利恩谈一谈。
text.description: 我想请你帮我完成另一个任务，$N。游侠戴戈利恩被派往晴风村去调查一起失心者袭击附近船坞的事。他要求增派援手，但目前我们人手不够。去找到他，尽你所能地帮助他。$B$B沿着鹰翼广场外的路一直往南走就可以到达晴风村了，祝你好运，$N。
text.completion: Thanks for coming, $n.  Things are worse than we had anticipated.  The Wretched have taken over Sunsail Anchorage in its entirety.

english.title: Fairbreeze Village
english.objectives: Speak to Ranger Degolien at Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.
english.description: I have another task for you, $N.  Ranger Degolien was sent to Fairbreeze Village to find out more about a Wretched attack on a nearby shipyard.  He has requested reinforcements which we cannot yet provide.  Seek him out and grant him whatever aid you can.$B$BFairbreeze Village can be reached by following the road out of Falconwing Square all the way towards the south.  Good luck, $N.
english.completion: Thanks for coming, $n.  Things are worse than we had anticipated.  The Wretched have taken over Sunsail Anchorage in its entirety.

text.title: 埃提耶什，守护者的传说之杖
text.objectives: 塔纳利斯时光之穴的安纳克罗斯要你带着阿泰丝,守护者之杖前往斯坦索姆，在圣化之地上使用它。击败从法杖内被驱除的生物再回去找他。
text.description: 最后一个任务会是最困难的，魔兽资料库网友。你要去迎头攻击巫妖王的将军跟上古之神，但是，你现在要面对的是萨格拉斯之手。$B带着这个法杖到斯坦索姆。你会看到圣化之地:而罗德隆最伟大的骑士就是在这里被谋杀的。把这污损的法杖放在圣化之地上，准备巨大力量由内破坏……毁灭这个支配法杖的邪恶东西，然后回到我这。
text.completed: Return to Anachronos at Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

english.title: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian
english.objectives: Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants you to take Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian to Stratholme and use it on Consecrated Earth. Defeat the entity that is exorcised from the staff and return to him.
english.description: This final task will be the most difficult of all, $N. You have faced and defeated both an Old God and the Lich King's General, but now you must face the hand of Sargeras.$B$BTake the staff to Stratholme. It is there that you will find a piece of consecrated earth: ground where the greatest knights of Lordaeron were murdered. Place the befouled staff upon the holy ground and prepare for an entity of immense power to break from within... Defeat the demonic being that controls the staff and return to me.
english.completed: Return to Anachronos at Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

text.title: 焦痕谷
text.objectives: 前往永歌森林西南方的焦痕谷寻找拉莉亚娜·河风。
text.description: 随着土壤中污染源的不断扩散，亡灵天灾将魔爪伸向了新的区域。过去，我们靠幽魂之地边界处的远古符石抵御侵略者，保护村落。$B$B天灾士兵在一次攻势中摧毁了最西边的符石，于是我们不得不焚毁符石四周的土地，阻止污染源扩散。$B$B我的姐妹拉莉亚娜·河风驻守在焦痕谷。去找她吧，或许她需要你的帮助。
text.completion: Ah, my brother sent you.  I do have a task I could use assistance with.

english.title: The Scorched Grove
english.objectives: Find Larianna Riverwind near the Scorched Grove in the southwest of Eversong Woods.
english.description: A foul taint in the soil precedes the expansion of the Scourge into a new area.  The protective runestones along the border with the Ghostlands have warded the land against this taint in the past.$B$BThe westernmost runestone was destroyed during a Scourge attack, which forced us to burn the ground around it to prevent the taint from spreading.$B$BMy sister, Larianna Riverwind, watches over the Scorched Grove.  Go find her; she might have some work for you.
english.completion: Ah, my brother sent you.  I do have a task I could use assistance with.

text.title: 血帆海盗的叛徒
text.progress: 里维加兹那个肮脏的家伙已经饶恕了所有愿意改过自新的血帆!那船底的人渣要我去杀了其他的人并把他们的面罩带回来做为证据。$B$B我不想这麽做，所以也不会叫你去做。帮我带来一些丝绸和红色染料，我就能制作合适的复制品。我会跟男爵说你变节了，但是请小心……血帆不会喜欢这个主意的!
text.completion: 让我们为这些阵亡的朋友哀悼，$N。$B$B<血帆背叛者对你咧嘴笑了笑，使了个眼色。>$B$B当一个背叛者是一回事，杀死你自己的兄弟……那才是真正可鄙的事!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Bloodsail Traitor in Stranglethorn Vale.

english.title: Traitor to the Bloodsail
english.completion: Let us observe a minute of silence for our fallen mates, $n. Being a traitor is one thing, murdering yer own buckos... that'd be just downright despicable, aye!
english.completed: Return to Bloodsail Traitor in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 调查暴风城的天谴军团
text.objectives: 从暴风城外的天谴军团身上收集三个暗淡的亡域之石并调查它们营地附近发光的符文法阵。
text.description: 巫妖王把他的不死生物派到我们的门口;我们不能坐视不管!你一定会站出来保卫暴风城不受可恶的入侵者骚扰吧?$B $B外面有些奇怪的符文法阵，散发着和周围不死生物与亡域上同样的能量。它们有一定的重要性，我肯定，而且我要你去调查出来。削减那些该死生物的数量，把它们死亡的证据和调查结果带来给我，我就会奖励你。去吧!
text.completion: 嗯。从你告诉我的事情，法阵里的声音……它们一定是被用来做为某种沟通的工具。我一想到那些邪恶的脑袋会透过这样的魔法联系就不寒而栗。无论如何，你看起来还是很健全很清醒。银色黎明感谢你的努力。
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Orrin at Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City.

english.title: Investigate the Scourge of Stormwind
english.objectives: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Stormwind and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
english.description: The Lich King has sent his undead upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Stormwind from these accursed invaders? $b $bThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you.  Go!
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Orrin at Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City.

text.objectives: 从铁炉堡外的天谴军团身上收集3个暗淡的墓地之石并调查它们营地附近发光的符文法阵。
text.description: 天谴军团就在我们的门边扎营;我能不能坐视不管!你一定会站出来保卫铁炉堡不受可恶的入侵者骚扰吧?$B $B外面有些奇怪的符文法阵，燃烧着和不死族周围及大墓地上一样的能量。它们有一定的重要性，我肯定，而且我要你去调查出来。削减那些异常物的数量;把它们死亡的证据和调查结果带来给我，我就会奖励你。去吧!
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Nevell at Gates of Ironforge in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 重修旧好
text.progress: 你一定是对我们或我们的朋友做了什麽可怕的事，$N。无论如何，我是来提供你一个方法赢回我们的好感。$B$B你知道，冬泉谷还满冷的。我们有这麽多的哥布林从别的城市过来，需要一些帮忙来保持温暖。帮我带一些丝绸和煤炭来我就会帮你说点好话。不过要小心，我们的敌人不会对你的帮忙产生好感的。
text.completion: 谢谢你，$N。你很快就重拾我们城镇对你的好感了。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Bronn Fitzwrench in Winterspring.

english.title: Making Amends
english.completion: Thank you, $n. You're on a quick path to redeeming yourself with our fair town.
english.completed: Return to Bronn Fitzwrench in Winterspring.

text.title: 修复旧创
text.progress: 你在到达棘齿城之前要考虑清楚，$N!到处都传言着你的肮脏行为。$B$B不过你运气不错，刚好有一艘和血帆海盗交战过、载满伤者的船只抵达。这是你证明自己不是彻底的坏蛋的机会。帮我们把制作绷带的亚麻布和装药水的空瓶子拿来。
text.completion: 我很高兴你这样弥补自身的过错，$N。继续将物资送来;我们不会那麽容易忘记你的，先生!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Mupsi Shacklefridd outside of Ratchet in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Mending Old Wounds
english.completion: I'm happy you're seeing the error of your ways, $n.  Keep the supplies coming; we're not going to forget about you so easily!
english.completed: Return to Mupsi Shacklefridd outside of Ratchet in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 海上之战
text.progress: 你想再次与塔纳利斯的哥布林交朋友吗，$N?我们正需要航海的材料和击败旧仇血帆海盗的枪枝。帮我把魔纹和强效助熔剂拿来，我们就能赦免你的罪过。
text.completion: 继续保持，$N。我们哥布林没那麽健忘!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Rumsen Fizzlebrack in Tanaris.

english.title: War at Sea
english.progress: You seek to befriend the goblins of Tanaris once again, $N? We're in need of materials for sails and guns to fight off our old enemies, the Bloodsail Buccaneers. Bring me mageweave and strong flux and we'll be on our way to pardoning your trespasses.
english.completion: Keep it coming, $n.  Us goblins don't forget that easily!
english.completed: Return to Rumsen Fizzlebrack in Tanaris.

text.title: 埃提耶什，守护者的传说之杖
text.objectives: 塔纳利斯时光之穴的安纳克罗斯要你带着阿泰丝,守护者之杖前往斯坦索姆，在圣化之地上使用它。击败从法杖内被驱除的生物再回去找他。
text.description: 最后一个任务会是最困难的，魔兽资料库网友。你要去迎头攻击巫妖王的将军跟上古之神，但是，你现在要面对的是萨格拉斯之手。$B带着这个法杖到斯坦索姆。你会看到圣化之地:而罗德隆最伟大的骑士就是在这里被谋杀的。把这污损的法杖放在圣化之地上，准备巨大力量由内破坏……毁灭这个支配法杖的邪恶东西，然后回到我这。
text.completed: Return to Anachronos at Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

text.title: 适宜的服装
text.completion: 呀……如果你真的那麽想加入我们老练水手的行列，你最好穿的像个水手一点!来，在我严责你之前快穿上适当的服饰。$B$B它们穿在你身上比穿在红眼阿班那个老家伙身上适合多了。他死在海上的一场暴风雨里。$B$B骄傲的穿着它吧，朋友!$B$B

text.title: 可口可乐宠物兑换券
text.completed: Return to She number one.

english.title: Redeem iCoke Prize Voucher
english.completed: Return to She number one.

text.title: 水中鬼魂
text.objectives: 在附近的湖泊周围杀死8个复仇的幽灵和8个贪婪的幽灵，然后向远行者营地的游侠克雷安复命。
text.description: $N，从我记事起，北边的湖泊就一直有先祖的鬼魂出没。那是一场悲惨的灾难，很多人被活活溺死，他们的灵魂仍在世间飘荡。$B$B虽然族人们对那场灾变的记忆已经模糊，但是湖边凄凉的哭泣声似乎在述说着他们被诅咒的命运。$B$B$N，如果你愿意接受这项任务，就去湖边结束他们的痛苦吧。我想……他们和我都会感激你的。
text.completion: I appreciate your help, $n.  It pains me to see the spirits of my ancestors in their pitiful state.  May they finally get the rest they deserve.
text.completed: Return to Ranger Krenn'an at Farstrider Enclave in Ghostlands.

english.title: Spirits of the Drowned
english.objectives: Ranger Krenn'an, at the Farstrider Enclave in the Ghostlands, wants you to kill 8 Vengeful Apparitions and 8 Ravening Apparitions in the nearby lake.
english.description: The lake to the north has been haunted by the ghosts of my ancestors for as long as I can remember, $N.  The poor souls were victims of a tragic incident in which scores of them drowned at the bottom of the lake.$B$BThe details of the event are mostly forgotten, but their haunting cries serve as a constant reminder of their curse.$B$BIf you're up to the task, I want you to go to the lake and put an end to their suffering, $N.  You will have my gratitude as well as theirs... I'm sure.
english.completion: I appreciate your help, $n.  It pains me to see the spirits of my ancestors in their pitiful state.  May they finally get the rest they deserve.
english.completed: Return to Ranger Krenn'an at Farstrider Enclave in Ghostlands.

text.title: 香料
text.objectives: 前往塞布努瓦的巨魔营地，给他们的食物中投毒，然后向远行者营地的药剂师温努图斯复命。
text.description: 我奉命从塔奎林来到远行者营地对付巨魔，而且我很快就想到了一个好法子。$B$B炼制一批强效毒药对我来说容易得很。你知道，巨魔这种生物总归要进食的吧，如果在他们的食物中投毒……唔，那一定非常有趣！$B$B你愿意帮我们消灭南面塞布努瓦的暗松巨魔吗？他们的营地分布在通往祖阿曼的道路的南北两侧。
text.completion: Ah, excellent! I knew that a $r-delivery system would make for the most efficient application of the poison. With any luck the Shadowpine trolls will get fat on it before keeling over. That should get them off of the backs of the Farstriders, and me back to Tranquillien. It has been a pleasure working with you, $c!
text.completed: Return to Apothecary Venustus at Farstrider Enclave in Ghostlands.

english.title: A Little Dash of Seasoning
english.objectives: Poison the Troll foodstuff at the camps in Zeb'Nowa and then return to Apothecary Venustus at the Farstrider Enclave in the Ghostlands.
english.description: I'm on loan to the Farstriders in an attempt to help with their troll difficulties. I believe that I have a solution to their problem.$B$BAt my disposal are a number of potent poisons. The trolls, as you know, are living creatures and therefore must eat. If we combine my poison with their food... well, I'm sure that the results will be entertaining!$B$BCare to help rid us of the Shadowpine trolls at Zeb'Nowa to the south? The camp straddles both the north and south sides of the road to Zul'Aman.
english.completion: Ah, excellent! I knew that a $r-delivery system would make for the most efficient application of the poison. With any luck the Shadowpine trolls will get fat on it before keeling over. That should get them off of the backs of the Farstriders, and me back to Tranquillien. It has been a pleasure working with you, $c!
english.completed: Return to Apothecary Venustus at Farstrider Enclave in Ghostlands.

text.title: 进攻塞布提拉
text.objectives: 杀死8个暗松影法师和8个暗松猎头者，然后向远行者营地的远行者索兰娜复命。
text.description: $C，远行者营地的兵力相当分散，我们迫切需要你的帮助。我奉命骚扰附近的暗松巨魔营地。根据作战计划，不能让暗松巨魔有任何喘息的机会，要闹得他们不得安宁，然后再伺机发动反攻，将这帮家伙统统消灭。$B$B因此，我们需要所有冒险者伸出援手，帮我们削减巨魔的数量。$B$B你愿意前往东边的塞布提拉，给巨魔们一点苦头吃吗？
text.completion: Good, good! You handled that very well! Let's see if you're up to something a little more difficult now.
text.completed: Return to Farstrider Solanna at Farstrider Enclave in Ghostlands.

english.title: Attack on Zeb'Tela
english.objectives: Kill 8 Shadowpine Shadowcasters and 8 Shadowpine Headhunters, and return to Farstrider Solanna at Farstrider Enclave in the Ghostlands.
english.description: Our resources are spread pretty thin here, $c, so your help is going to be invaluable.  The captain has tasked me with overseeing the harassment of the local Shadowpine troll camps. We have a policy of keeping them off balance until the day when we can launch a brutal offensive to wipe them out.$B$BUntil then, we need all of the volunteers that we can get so that those Shadowpine troll numbers are decreased.$B$BThink you could head east to Zeb'Tela and hurt them a little?
english.completion: Good, good! You handled that very well! Let's see if you're up to something a little more difficult now.
english.completed: Return to Farstrider Solanna at Farstrider Enclave in Ghostlands.

text.title: 突袭塞布努瓦
text.objectives: 杀死10个暗松驭豹者和10个暗松妖术师，然后向远行者营地的远行者索兰娜复命。
text.description: 接下来的这项任务稍微有点挑战性。南边的塞布努瓦聚集了一批更强的暗松巨魔。我们要继续削减巨魔的数量；因此，我派你前往塞布努瓦对付暗松巨魔，随便你用什么方法，杀死他们就成。$B$B$N，怎么样？你准备好了吗？
text.completion: Unbelievable! You really should talk to the captain about joining up as a Farstrider. Alright, $n, you've given us the breathing room that we need to continue building up our forces here. Actually, by your account there aren't many of those trolls left at all! Maybe now we can join with Tranquillien and attack Deatholme? I think you've earned a little something. Take your pick.
text.completed: Return to Farstrider Solanna at Farstrider Enclave in Ghostlands.

english.title: Assault on Zeb'Nowa
english.objectives: Kill 10 Shadowpine Catlords and 10 Shadowpine Hexxers, and return to Farstrider Solanna at the Farstrider Enclave in the Ghostlands.
english.description: Time for something a little more challenging. Zeb'Nowa, to the south, is where the more powerful Shadowpine trolls make their home. In our continuing effort to keep the troll numbers to a minimum I'm dispatching you to go down there and assail them by whatever means you have at your disposal.$B$BWhat do you say, $N? Ready to deal with some more trolls?
english.completion: Unbelievable! You really should talk to the captain about joining up as a Farstrider. Alright, $n, you've given us the breathing room that we need to continue building up our forces here. Actually, by your account there aren't many of those trolls left at all! Maybe now we can join with Tranquillien and attack Deatholme? I think you've earned a little something. Take your pick.
english.completed: Return to Farstrider Solanna at Farstrider Enclave in Ghostlands.

text.title: 欢迎!
text.objectives: Bring the Azure Watch Gift Voucher to Jaeleil in Azure Watch.
text.description: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!$B$BAs special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Jaeleil in Azure Watch.  You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.$B$BThanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!$B$B
text.progress: 您好!很高兴见到您!$B$B我看到您手里拿着一张特殊的礼品券，把它交给我，您就可以得到一件特殊的礼品!
text.completion: 您一定会成为一个真正的英雄，$N。欢迎您来到艾泽拉斯世界，请从我们为您精心准备的特殊礼品中挑选一件吧!$B$B

english.title: Welcome!
english.objectives: Bring the Azure Watch Gift Voucher to Jaeleil in Azure Watch.
english.description: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!$B$BAs special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Jaeleil in Azure Watch.  You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.$B$BThanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!$B$B

text.title: 你活下来了！
text.objectives: 与埃门谷坠毁点的普罗尼图斯谈一谈。
text.description: 别管我的伤势了，$G兄弟:姐妹;。我们当中有任何人能够活下来，就已经是个奇迹了！$B$B看来你对目前的情况并不是很清楚，毕竟你一直休眠了好几周的时间。$B$B迁跃的途中发生了一些事，埃索达也因此坠毁了。许多人都已经死了。$B$B但我一直确信你还活着，$N。有你在为我们努力的话，我想我们的情况很快就能转危为安的！普罗尼图斯让我在你醒了之后把你叫去他那里，他就在山脚下等着你呢。沿路向西南走过去就可以找到他了。
text.completion: $n, by my eternal soul, it is good to see you!  I don't know why the Exodar crashed.  Only those of us that were in this part of the ship remain. There's not much time if we're to save everyone that we can!

english.title: You Survived!
english.objectives: Speak with Proenitus at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
english.description: Nevermind my injuries, $g brother : sister;. It's a miracle that any of us are alive!$b$bIt didn't look like you'd pull through; you've been in suspension for weeks.$B$BSomething happened and the Exodar crashed. Many have died.$B$BBut I'm relieved that you are alive, $N. With you leading our efforts, I'm sure we'll get to safety soon! Proenitus asked me to send you to him when you awoke. He's waiting for you at the bottom of the hill. Just follow the path southwest.
english.completion: $n, by my eternal soul, it is good to see you!  I don't know why the Exodar crashed.  Only those of us that were in this part of the ship remain. There's not much time if we're to save everyone that we can!

text.title: 补充治疗水晶
text.objectives: Acquire 6 Vials of Moth Blood from the nearby Vale Moths and give them to Proenitus at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
text.description: 我们目前最紧迫的问题就是，治疗水晶的存量已经几乎为零了。我们必须立刻补充这种水晶。$B$B但糟糕的是，目前补充水晶的唯一可行办法就是从周围的蛾类生物血液中分解出有用的物质，因为它们的血液中含有某种非常合适的替代品。$B$B这些蛾类生物在谷中遍地都是，西北方更加集中一些。
text.progress: $n, have you harvested the necessary moth blood for the healing crystals yet?  With survivors scattered all over the vale, time is of the essence!
text.completion: Regrettable that those creatures had to die so that we might live - indiscriminate killing is not the $r way.  However, the blood you gathered will replenish our healing crystals, so their deaths will not be in vain.
text.completed: Return to Proenitus at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

english.title: Replenishing the Healing Crystals
english.objectives: Acquire 6 Vials of Moth Blood from the nearby Vale Moths and give them to Proenitus at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
english.description: Our immediate concern is the depleted state of our healing crystals.  We must replenish them quickly!$B$BUnfortunately, the only way to do this at this point is to extract the blood from the local vale moths.  Their blood will make for a suitable substitute.$B$BThe moths can be found in many places around the vale, but they are mostly concentrated in the northwest.
english.progress: $n, have you harvested the necessary moth blood for the healing crystals yet?  With survivors scattered all over the vale, time is of the essence!
english.completion: Regrettable that those creatures had to die so that we might live - indiscriminate killing is not the $r way.  However, the blood you gathered will replenish our healing crystals, so their deaths will not be in vain.
english.completed: Return to Proenitus at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

text.title: 清理道路
text.objectives: 杀死10只巨型纺丝蜘蛛和10只鬼爪破坏者，然后向幽魂之地安迪尔林庄园的学徒沃尔伊复命。
text.description: 魔导师坎迪瑞斯派我来这里猎杀那些具有攻击性的野生动物。如果能解除这些家伙构成的威胁，我们就准备在这块地方建立一座前哨站，监视亡灵天灾的动向。$B$B要说我在做学徒时学会了什么诀窍，那就是把事情委托给别人来做——尤其是那些有生命危险的事情！$B$B如果你感兴趣的话，就去西边和南边猎杀巨型纺丝蜘蛛和鬼爪破坏者，我会给你一笔不小的报酬。
text.completion: Thanks for giving me a hand, $n.  I was dreading the thought of venturing into the woods this close to Deatholme.
text.completed: Return to Apprentice Vor'el at Andilien Estate in Ghostlands.

english.title: Clearing the Way
english.objectives: Apprentice Vor'el at Andilien Estate in the Ghostlands wants you to slay 10 Greater Spindlewebs and 10 Ghostclaw Ravagers.
english.description: Magister Kaendris sent me down here to clear the area of any hostile wildlife.  Once this area is secured, the magisters plan to turn it into some sort of advance outpost against the Scourge.$B$BNow if there's one thing I've learned as an apprentice it's to delegate responsibility - especially in matters that endanger one's life!$B$BIf you're interested, I'll pay you well to kill the greater spindlewebs and ghostclaw ravagers to the west and south of here.
english.completion: Thanks for giving me a hand, $n.  I was dreading the thought of venturing into the woods this close to Deatholme.
english.completed: Return to Apprentice Vor'el at Andilien Estate in Ghostlands.

text.title: 远行者营地
text.objectives: 太阳圣殿的魔导师坎迪瑞斯要你去跟幽魂之地远行者营地的游侠维恩娜谈一谈。
text.description: $N，魔导师和远行者不可能随时保持看法一致。但是说到达尔坎，我们都认为必须设法击败他和他的军团。$B$B东北方远行者营地的游侠维恩娜掌握了敌人的重要信息。去跟她谈谈，看看能不能帮上忙。
text.completion: Kaendris sent you?  I might have a task for you, $c.

english.title: The Farstrider Enclave
english.objectives: Magister Kaendris, at the Sanctum of the Sun, wants you to talk to Ranger Vynna at the Farstrider Enclave in the Ghostlands.
english.description: Magisters and Farstriders may not see eye to eye all the time, $N.  When it comes to Dar'Khan, however, we're all in agreement that a way must be found to defeat him and his legions.$B$BRanger Vynna, at the Farstrider Enclave northeast of here, has come across important information regarding our enemy.  Speak to her and see if you can be of assistance.
english.completion: Kaendris sent you?  I might have a task for you, $c.

text.title: 拯救幸存者！
text.objectives: 使用你的“纳鲁的赐福”这一能力拯救埃门谷中的任意一名德莱尼幸存者，然后向埃门谷坠毁点的扎尔杜复命。
text.description: 治疗水晶终于补足了，但这不是我们唯一的帮助伤者的方式。所有德莱尼人都曾受到过纳鲁的赐福，得到了治疗的能力。$B$B你一定要善用这种能力去帮助幸存者。$B$B在这里的西边和西北边，你会发现大量的幸存者，埃索达坠毁时，他们跳船逃生，散落在了谷中。$B$B这些幸存者大多是被能量水晶的辐射严重灼伤，所以你可以通过包围着他们躯体的红光发现他们。$B$B你一定要赶快救救他们，$N。
text.completion: The Light be praised! You've done what only a true hero could have done, $n! The $r you saved owes their continued life to your selflessness! Please, take this supply pouch. You look like you can use it more than I.
text.completed: Return to Zalduun at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

english.title: Rescue the Survivors!
english.objectives: Use your Gift of the Naaru ability on one of the Draenei Survivors spread throughout Ammen Vale, then return to Zalduun at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
english.description: The healing crystals are replenished, but that is not the only way we can help the injured. All draenei can tap the gift of the Naaru to heal. You must use this ability to heal one of the crash survivors.$b$bYou'll find most of the survivors in the areas to the west and northwest, but the crash scattered us all over the vale.$b$bThe survivors have suffered from exposure to the irradiated power crystals, so you should be able to find them by the red glow that surround them.$B$BYou must save them, $N.
english.completion: The Light be praised! You've done what only a true hero could have done, $n! The $r you saved owes their continued life to your selflessness! Please, take this supply pouch. You look like you can use it more than I.
english.completed: Return to Zalduun at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

text.title: 破碎的死灵水晶
text.objectives: 将破碎的墓地水晶带给暴风城城门外的欧令中尉。
text.description: 在陷入憎恨的尸体身上，你发现破碎的水晶，以微弱的能量缓慢地跳动着。
text.progress: 你需要协助吗?
text.completion: 嗯，你从一具受到憎恨侵袭的尸体身上取得这项物品?$B$B我们已听说天谴军团召唤亡域基础营地的事。我猜他们想在暴风城里也造一个。很好，这样他们就等着迎接失败吧。

english.title: Cracked Necrotic Crystal
english.objectives: Bring the Cracked Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Orrin outside the gates of Stormwind.
english.description: On the corpse of the fallen abomination, you discover a cracked crystal, slowly pulsing with necrotic energy.

text.title: 必需的措施……
text.objectives: 收集10份鞭笞者样本，把它们交给埃门谷坠毁点的植物学家塔蕾克丝。
text.description: 有一块从船体中脱离出来的能量水晶掉落入了附近的一处湖泊中，污染了湖水。埃门谷中的许多植物与动物都因此而受到了辐射的影响，产生了变异。$B$B我目前构思出了一个方法，或许可以消除湖水的污染，但我必须首先进行一些分析实验，这需要一些变异鞭笞者的样本进行分析。在西边的埃门平原一带就可以找到这些变异生物。$B$B你愿意帮我采集一些样本回来吗，$C？
text.progress: I'll need all of the samples in good condition if we're to have a chance of cleansing the lake. We don't have much time, $c!
text.completion: These will do. Thank you, $c! While you were out, I managed to gather some equipment together to make an analysis of the samples.  This should only take a moment.
text.completed: Return to Botanist Taerix at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

english.title: What Must Be Done...
english.objectives: Gather 10 Lasher Samples and return them to Botanist Taerix at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
english.description: The nearby lake has been contaminated by one of the ship's power crystals.  Many of the plants and animals of Ammen Vale have been mutated because of this.$B$BI have a theory on how to heal the lake, but I must have samples from the mutated lashers for analysis.  They can be found to the west in the Ammen Fields.$B$BWill you help me, $c?
english.progress: I'll need all of the samples in good condition if we're to have a chance of cleansing the lake. We don't have much time, $c!
english.completion: These will do. Thank you, $c! While you were out, I managed to gather some equipment together to make an analysis of the samples.  This should only take a moment.
english.completed: Return to Botanist Taerix at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

text.title: 净化湖水
text.objectives: 将中和媒介散布在辐射能量水晶旁，然后向埃门谷坠毁点的植物学家塔蕾克丝复命。
text.description: 谢天谢地，我想这应该是有效的！我现在给你一份中和媒介，你要将它洒在南方的银链湖中。它将中和能量水晶所产生的辐射效果。$B$B到了湖边之后，你需要游进湖里去，将中和媒介倒在水晶周围。不用担心，你不会在辐射下暴露很长时间的。
text.progress: The sooner you disperse the agent at the lake, the fewer native creatures that will be mutated by drinking the water, including ourselves!$B$BI'm sorry that we can't do anything to help the poor creatures that have already been infected. If only my lab equipment were intact.
text.completion: From what you describe, the neutralizing agent worked! I just wish that I knew how long it will last; we really need to remove that power crystal from the lake entirely. Thank you, $n! I will tell Tedon to try the neutralizing agent on one of the captured beasts at once.
text.completed: Return to Botanist Taerix at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

english.title: Healing the Lake
english.objectives: Disperse the Neutralizing Agent at the Irradiated Power Crystal, then return to Botanist Taerix at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
english.description: Thank goodness, I think it'll work!  I have an agent for you to spread at Silverline Lake to the south.  It will neutralize the effects of the irradiated ship's power crystal that fell there.$B$BSwim out and scatter the neutralizing agent near it.  Don't worry, you won't be exposed long enough to become irradiated.
english.progress: The sooner you disperse the agent at the lake, the fewer native creatures that will be mutated by drinking the water, including ourselves!$B$BI'm sorry that we can't do anything to help the poor creatures that have already been infected. If only my lab equipment were intact.
english.completion: From what you describe, the neutralizing agent worked! I just wish that I knew how long it will last; we really need to remove that power crystal from the lake entirely. Thank you, $n! I will tell Tedon to try the neutralizing agent on one of the captured beasts at once.
english.completed: Return to Botanist Taerix at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

text.title: 来自前线的信
text.objectives: 将撕破的信件带到东瘟疫之地的圣光之愿礼拜堂交给名册保管者。
text.description: 你在杀掉的众多天谴军团爪牙其中一人身上找到这封信。从它的样子和气味判断，它已经和不死族在一起一些日子了。或许圣光之愿礼拜堂的某人会对它有兴趣进而好好的研究它……

english.title: Letter from the Front
english.objectives: Take the Torn Letter to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...

text.title: reuse
text.objectives: Deliver the Dim Necrotic Stone to SOMEONE.
text.description: This stone radiates a dark energy. You should deliver it to SOMEONE.

text.title: 前线的便笺
text.objectives: 将干净的便笺带到东瘟疫之地的圣光之愿礼拜堂交给名册保管者。
text.description: 你在杀掉的众多天谴军团爪牙其中一人身上找到这封信。从它的样子和气味判断，它已经和不死族在一起一些日子了。或许圣光之愿礼拜堂的某人会对它有兴趣进而好好的研究它……
text.progress: 什么事吗?你手里拿着的是什么?

english.title: Note from the Front
english.objectives: Take the Careworn Note to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...

text.title: 前线的书页

text.title: 疫苗
text.objectives: 对6只木巢枭兽使用疫苗水晶，然后向埃门谷坠毁点的守备官奥达尔复命。
text.description: 沙娜安需要我们帮她回收一些埃索达的零件。塔蕾克丝准备了一个接种装置，它可以让生活在附近这片地区的木巢枭兽得到拯救。$B$B你只需靠近那些尚未被辐射影响到的枭兽，然后对它们使用这枚水晶就可以了。而那些已经被辐射影响的枭兽……很遗憾，你只能杀死它们。到东南方的木巢山去，枭兽们就居住在那里的木巢林地中。
text.progress: The more we can do to clear up Nestlewood, the faster Zhanaa can get back to work.
text.completion: With many of the owlkin now inoculated, we can focus on getting out of here and not have to worry about wiping out the owlkin population in the area. Here, choose from these.  You've done good work, and you deserve to be rewarded!
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Aldar at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

english.title: Inoculation
english.objectives: Use the Inoculating Crystal on 6 Nestlewood Owlkin. Then return to Vindicator Aldar at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
english.description: Zhanaa needs our help to salvage parts from the Exodar.  Taerix prepared an inoculum that can be given to the Nestlewood owlkin that live in the area of a lot of the salvage.$B$BJust get close to the unaffected ones and use the crystal on them.  Unfortunately, you'll have to kill the others.  You'll find the owlkin at Nestlewood Thicket and Nestlewood Hills to the southeast.
english.progress: The more we can do to clear up Nestlewood, the faster Zhanaa can get back to work.
english.completion: With many of the owlkin now inoculated, we can focus on getting out of here and not have to worry about wiping out the owlkin population in the area. Here, choose from these.  You've done good work, and you deserve to be rewarded!
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Aldar at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

text.title: 备用材料
text.objectives: 收集4份发射器备用零件，然后向埃门谷坠毁点的技师沙娜安复命。
text.description: 我们最近成功地从坠毁地区回收了一个已经损坏的全息图象发射器。如果我们能把它修好，就有机会找到其他在埃门谷之外的幸存者了。$B$B埃索达坠毁时，有些备用零件也散落出了船外。本来我们可以迅速回收的，可它们现在被这一地区的枭兽全部运走了。$B$B$N，你必须立刻到南方的木巢林地和木巢山去，回收那些备用零件。
text.progress: When we have those spare parts, I know that we'll get this emitter repaired. With any luck there will be someone else out there left to talk to.
text.completion: Let me take a look at those. Yes, I think that these will do nicely; good job, $n. The emitter is rather complex so it may take some time to finish the repairs. I'll let you know when it's ready. In the meantime, you might see if Vindicator Aldar has anything he could use you for.
text.completed: Return to Technician Zhanaa at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

english.title: Spare Parts
english.objectives: Collect 4 Emitter Spare Parts and then return to Technician Zhanaa at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
english.description: We managed to recover a damaged holographic emitter from the crash. If we repair it, we'll have a chance to find other survivors outside of Ammen Vale.$B$BThere were devices from the ship that could be salvaged for spare parts in the area, but the local owlkin carried them off before we could get to them. $B$B$N, you must go south to Nestlewood Thicket and Hills to find the spare parts.
english.progress: When we have those spare parts, I know that we'll get this emitter repaired. With any luck there will be someone else out there left to talk to.
english.completion: Let me take a look at those. Yes, I think that these will do nicely; good job, $n. The emitter is rather complex so it may take some time to finish the repairs. I'll let you know when it's ready. In the meantime, you might see if Vindicator Aldar has anything he could use you for.
english.completed: Return to Technician Zhanaa at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

text.title: <DEPRECATED>Speak with Vindicator Aldar
text.objectives: 与埃门谷坠毁点的守备官奥达尔谈一谈。
text.description: $N, Vindicator Aldar has been looking for someone to take care of a problem that we're having with the mutated owlkin at Nestlewood Thicket.  We must deal with an unfortunate side effect of our unintended arrival here.$B$BYou'll find him outside to the south in the crash site. Please, speak with him as soon as you can.

english.title: <DEPRECATED>Speak with Vindicator Aldar
english.objectives: Speak with Vindicator Aldar at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

We must deal with an unfortunate side effect of our unintended arrival here.$B$BYou'll find him outside to the south in the crash site. Please, speak with him as soon as you can.

text.title: <DEPRECATED>Compassion
text.objectives: Kill 14 Mutated Owlkin and then return to Vindicator Aldar at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
text.description: Nearby Silverline Lake was contaminated by a piece of the ship that fell into it.  This in turn has caused the mutation of most of the creatures in the area, some of which have turned hostile.  The worst of these are the mutated owlkin.$B$BGo south into Nestlewood Thicket and put down as many of these pitiful creatures as you can.  It's a mercy killing, $c, so please make it quick and painless.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Aldar at The Sacred Grove in Azuremyst Isle.

text.title: <DEPRECATED>Blood Elf Remains?
text.objectives: Take the Blood Elf Amulet to Vindicator Aldar at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
text.description: 你相信这些是一个罪犯多雷的遗体 - 一个血精灵 - 躺在地上的死亡。从它的表情看来，他是受害者，至少有一些在丛林中变异的猫头鹰的野蛮爪子。$B$B搜索尸体，你发现

english.title: <DEPRECATED>Blood Elf Remains?
english.objectives: Take the Blood Elf Amulet to Vindicator Aldar at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
english.description: You believe that these are the remains of one of the sin'dorei -- a blood elf -- laying dead here on the ground.  By the look of it he fell victim to the savage claws of at least a few of the mutated owlkin in the thicket.$B$BSearching the body, you uncover an amulet on a chain around his neck.  Perhaps this would be of interest to Vindicator Aldar?

text.title: 失踪的斥候
text.objectives: 在埃门谷中的暗影山找到图兰，并与之交谈。
text.description: 我们最近数次确认了暗影山附近有一些非正常活动的迹象。$B$B这很让人不安，我已经向那里派出了数名斥候，要求他们彻底侦察那边的信息。但其中有一名斥候现在仍然还未回来，也没有收到他的报告。$B$B$C，我要求你立刻去西南方侦察，到湖的另一边找到图兰，然后看看是什么让他迟到了。
text.completion: Help... blood elves!  They... ambushed... me.  Don't have... long.

english.title: The Missing Scout
english.objectives: Find and speak with Tolaan at Shadow Ridge in Ammen Vale.
english.description: We now have several separate confirmations of unusual activity up on the Shadow Ridge.$B$BThis is disturbing; we thought that the scouting missions already undertaken had been thorough. One of my scouts hasn't reported back yet.$B$B$C, I need you to head southwest to the other side of Silverline Lake and find Tolaan, and see what has delayed him.
english.completion: Help... blood elves!  They... ambushed... me.  Don't have... long.

text.title: 暗淡的死灵水晶
text.objectives: 将黯淡的亡域水晶带给幽暗城庭院的卢卡中尉。
text.description: 在死去的活尸身上，你找到了一个散发着死灵能量的水晶。

english.title: Faint Necrotic Crystal
english.objectives: Bring the Faint Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Rukag in the courtyard of the Undercity.
english.description: On the corpse of the fallen wight, you find a crystal faintly radiating necrotic energy.

text.title: 血精灵间谍
text.objectives: 杀死测量员卡蒂瑞丝，并把这个消息通知给埃门谷坠毁点的守备官奥达尔。
text.description: 我有一个计划，我们必须杀死他们的领袖。没有了领袖，他们也许就会立刻撤退并重组，这样我们就获得了修复装置的宝贵时间。$B$B守备官奥达尔应该明白这一点。杀死血精灵的测量员，然后向他报告我们发现的一切。
text.completion: I thank you for dealing with the blood elf surveyor.  Surely she was their leader.  Rest assured, we will deal with whatever remnant of them is still nearby. Please, take one of these weapons as a sign of my gratitude.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Aldar at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

english.title: Blood Elf Spy
english.objectives: Slay Surveyor Candress and then inform Vindicator Aldar at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
english.description: I have a plan. We must kill their leader. Without their master, perhaps they will retreat to regroup. We just need to buy time until the repairs are completed.$b$bThen Vindicator Aldar must know of this. Kill the surveyor, then return and tell him what we've found.
english.completion: I thank you for dealing with the blood elf surveyor.  Surely she was their leader.  Rest assured, we will deal with whatever remnant of them is still nearby. Please, take one of these weapons as a sign of my gratitude.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Aldar at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

text.title: 图像发射器
text.objectives: 与埃门谷坠毁点的技师沙娜安谈一谈。
text.description: $N，在你去调查暗影山的情况时，沙娜安已经快把全息图象发射器修理好了。你去与她谈谈吧。
text.completion: I got it, I got it!  I think I managed to fix the emitter!  Here, I'll just activate this last crystal and that should do it. Take a look at the emitter, $n.  It looks like it's beginning to work... someone is appearing!

english.title: The Emitter
english.objectives: Speak with Technician Zhanaa at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
english.description: $N, while you were out investigating the Shadow Ridge, Zhanaa here has been going on about the holographic emitter.  You might want to speak with her.
english.completion: I got it, I got it!  I think I managed to fix the emitter!  Here, I'll just activate this last crystal and that should do it. Take a look at the emitter, $n.  It looks like it's beginning to work... someone is appearing!

text.title: 前往碧蓝岗哨
text.objectives: 与秘蓝岛的碧蓝岗哨中的技师戴维恩谈一谈。
text.description: 总算有了个不错的结果。$N，现在你立刻前往这个碧蓝岗哨去找戴维恩！$B$B你看，这里有一条小小的通路一直向西，可以走到这座小岛的外侧。之后，你需要跨过这条晶水河，到达另一边那座较大的岛屿上，继续沿着路走就可以找到碧蓝岗哨了。$B$B到了那边以后，看看是否能说服他们派遣一些救援人员带着补给过来。我们这里剩下的人也很快就会在适当时候迁移过去的。$B$B谢谢你，没有你的帮助我们不可能取得这样的进展！
text.completion: Ah, good to see you again!  I'm glad that we were both able to get our emitters fixed or we might never have found one another.  And don't worry, we'll see to it that Ammen Vale gets help and supplies. Speaking of assistance, now that you're here, go around and introduce yourself to the others.  I know that there's plenty to do.

english.title: Travel to Azure Watch
english.objectives: Speak with Technician Dyvuun at Azure Watch on Azuremyst Isle.
english.description: By all that is good, $N, you must go at once to this Azure Watch and speak with Dyvuun!$B$BThere is a path that leads west off of this tiny isle.  Follow it and cross the Crystalbrook River to arrive on the larger part of the isle.  Continue to follow the path and you should find Azure Watch.$B$BSee if you can convince them to send us some aid and supplies.  The rest of us will follow when we can.$B$BThank you, we wouldn't have made it without you!
english.completion: Ah, good to see you again!  I'm glad that we were both able to get our emitters fixed or we might never have found one another.  And don't worry, we'll see to it that Ammen Vale gets help and supplies. Speaking of assistance, now that you're here, go around and introduce yourself to the others.  I know that there's plenty to do.

text.title: 碧蓝岗哨的消息
text.objectives: 与秘蓝岛上的碧蓝岗哨中的看护员谢尔兰谈一谈。
text.description: $C！刚才有一些变异生物突然跳出来，把我的腿弄伤了。$B$B我原本是在碧蓝岗哨收到了沙娜安的信息之后，被派出来执行侦察任务的。现在，是否能请你代替我向看护员谢尔兰汇报一下？她必须获知这边到底有多少人在等待碧蓝岗哨的支援。你只需要渡过晶水河，然后一直沿路走，就可以到达碧蓝岗哨了。$B$B假如你需要在那边休息的话，也可以让她帮你安排一个简便的住所。
text.completion: Oh, you must be one of the survivors we've been hearing about! I'm glad that you came. Don't worry, we will send someone to see to Aeun's injured leg. I'm most interested in hearing all about your harrowing story of survival. You're a brave one to have made it all the way here.

english.title: Word from Azure Watch
english.objectives: Speak with Caregiver Chellan at Azure Watch on Azuremyst Isle.
english.description: $C! A couple mutated beasts jumped me and my leg is injured.$B$BI was sent on a scouting mission from Azure Watch after we received word from Zhanaa. Please, could you go speak with Caregiver Chellan in my stead? She needs to know how many people to expect in Azure Watch. Just cross the Crystalbrook River here and continue following the road until you get to Azure Watch.$B$BBe sure to ask her for a place for yourself to stay in.
english.completion: Oh, you must be one of the survivors we've been hearing about! I'm glad that you came. Don't worry, we will send someone to see to Aeun's injured leg. I'm most interested in hearing all about your harrowing story of survival. You're a brave one to have made it all the way here.

text.title: 阿诺克苏塔
text.objectives: 杀死阿诺克苏塔，然后向幽魂之地塔奎林的奥术师范迪瑞尔复命。
text.description: Come closer, I am ... dying.$B$BI was sent here ... to slay these Nerubians, but Vandril didn't ... know that they have a leader.$B$B<The dying blood elf coughs up a good amount of blood.>$B$BYou must find and ... slay Anok'suten.  Get help.  She wanders around ... Suncrown Village.
text.completion: I apologize for the shoddy intelligence, $c.  Had I known of this Anok'suten ahead of time, I surely would have told you. We're spread too thin and things are slipping through the cracks!
text.completed: Return to Arcanist Vandril at Tranquillien in Ghostlands.

english.title: Anok'suten
english.objectives: Slay Anok'suten and return to Arcanist Vandril at Tranquillien in the Ghostlands.
english.description: Come closer, I am ... dying.$B$BI was sent here ... to slay these Nerubians, but Vandril didn't ... know that they have a leader.$B$B<The dying blood elf coughs up a good amount of blood.>$B$BYou must find and ... slay Anok'suten.  Get help.  She wanders around ... Suncrown Village.
english.completion: I apologize for the shoddy intelligence, $c.  Had I known of this Anok'suten ahead of time, I surely would have told you. We're spread too thin and things are slipping through the cracks!
english.completed: Return to Arcanist Vandril at Tranquillien in Ghostlands.

text.title: [TXT] Goblin Savages
text.objectives: Brianna Schneider on Designer Island wants 10 Goblin Teeth.
text.description: <Brianna gives you a searching glance.>$B$BSo, you want to kill some goblins, eh? Well, if you're determined, you can start with the nearby savages. Bring me their teeth as proof of your deeds.
text.completed: Return to Bri's Test Character in Designer Island.

text.completed: Return to Argent Quartermaster.

english.completed: Return to Argent Quartermaster.

text.completed: Return to Argent Quartermaster.

english.title: Blessed Wizard Oil
english.completed: Return to Argent Quartermaster.

text.title: 黑暗中的光明
text.objectives: 找到并碰触在黑石塔、厄运之槌、通灵学院和斯坦索姆内的火盆，并回到节日护火者处。
text.description: 我们不是这世界上唯一庆祝这个节日的人， $N。所有种族，所有文化，都曾为火焰的寓意所深深触动。即使是在这世界上最阴暗、最寒冷的处所，仍有明亮的火焰在跳动。$B$B如果你想自己证实这一点，就到那些地下城里去看看吧。去看看通灵学院、斯坦索姆、黑石塔和厄运之槌厅堂内的篝火，我会在这里等你回来的。
text.progress: 你找到你在黑暗中的路了吗?
text.completed: Return to Earthen Ring Elder.

english.title: A Light in Dark Places
english.objectives: Find and touch the bonfires located within Blackrock Spire, Dire Maul, Scholomance, and Stratholme, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
english.description: We are not the only ones who celebrate this holiday, $n. All creatures, all cultures, are touched by the flame. Even in the darkest places, the fires are being lit.$b$bIf you wish to see them for yourself, travel into the depths. Seek out the bonfires burning within Stratholme, Scholomance, among the ogres of Dire Maul, and the halls of Blackrock Spire itself; I will await your return.
english.completed: Return to Earthen Ring Elder.

text.title: 超级法力药水
text.completed: Return to Argent Outfitter.

english.title: Super Mana Potion
english.completed: Return to Argent Outfitter.

text.title: 超级治疗药水
text.completed: Return to Argent Quartermaster.

english.title: Super Healing Potion
english.completed: Return to Argent Quartermaster.

text.title: 卡利姆多的野火
text.objectives: 造访艾萨拉、希利苏斯、安戈洛环行山和冬泉谷的仲夏庆典营地，然后回到节日护火者处。
text.description: 艾泽拉斯世界上的每一处地方都会庆祝仲夏的来临，广袤的卡利姆多大陆也是如此，或许你会有兴趣那那边看一看。$B$B若你没有真正地感受过那些熊熊燃烧着的火焰，那么你是无法彻底了解仲夏的。庆祝者已经在寒冷的冬泉谷西部、艾萨拉东北部、希利苏斯废土上的勇士之墓附近，以及富饶美丽的安戈洛环行山入口处都点起了火焰，去看看吧。你的旅程结束以后，别忘了回来找我。
text.progress: 卡林多的火焰烧地旺吗?
text.completion: 你的精神闪耀着卡林多火焰温暖的光，朋友。热度不够鼓舞你吗?$B$B一旦力量从你身上褪去，或许这些能够帮你重新振作感觉。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Festival Flamekeeper.

english.title: Wild Fires in Kalimdor
english.objectives: Visit the Midsummer camps located in Azshara, Silithus, Un'Goro Crater, and Winterspring, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
english.description: The Midsummer Fire Festival is celebrated everywhere in Azeroth, and the diverse land of Kalimdor is no exception. You look fit to travel -- perhaps a journey is in order.$b$bMidsummer cannot be truly appreciated unless you've seen the blistering blue fires abroad. The celebrants have lit fires in chilly western Winterspring, northeastern Azshara, near Valor's Rest in the wastes of Silithus, and by the entrance to lush Un'Goro. Return once your journey is complete.
english.completed: Return to Festival Flamekeeper.

text.title: 东部王国的野火
text.objectives: 造访诅咒之地、东瘟疫之地、辛特兰和灼热峡谷的火焰节营地，然后回到节日护火者处。
text.description: 我们的庆典已经在全世界展开了，$C。几乎每一处地方都已经点燃了圣火，在节日光辉的照耀之下，强大的火焰映射着明亮的蓝天。去寻找它们吧。$B$B有一处就在黑石塔的北方。其它的火焰，有的在东瘟疫之地一处衰败的城镇前，有的在辛特兰悬崖的路旁，还有在诅咒之地的黑暗之门附近。$B$B去寻找它们吧，旅程结束后回来找我。
text.progress: 要战胜这个威胁需要一些时间。你的进展如何，$N?
text.completion: 啊，你来了。有点疲倦，有点脏乱，但是很有知识!热情在这个季节都深触我们的心并让我们团结在一起;你的人也和你所触摸的火焰一起发光发热。$B$B啊，但是这年头教化已经不是出任务很好的奖励了，我想。收下这些，然後，尽情在庆典上玩乐吧。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Festival Flamekeeper.

english.title: Wild Fires in the Eastern Kingdoms
english.objectives: Visit the Fire Festival camps located in Blasted Lands, Eastern Plaguelands, the Hinterlands and Searing Gorge, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
english.description: Our celebration of the flame is spread throughout the land, $c. Not a single place remains untouched by the heat of this holiday, and the strongest fires burn a brilliant blue. Seek them out.$b$bYou'll find one just north of Blackrock Spire. The others are located deep within the Eastern Plaguelands near a decrepit town, along the road to the cliffs within the mountainous Hinterlands, and on the way to the Dark Portal within the Blasted Lands.$b$b Return once your journey is done.
english.completed: Return to Festival Flamekeeper.

text.title: 盗取奥格瑞玛的烈焰
text.objectives: 将奥格瑞玛烈焰交给节日博学者。
text.description: 从奥格瑞玛中心偷来的烈焰令你感到异常的温暖。你对这种罕见的力量一无所知，但是博学者或许知道些什么……
text.progress: 你看起来很抢眼，$R。你带了什麽来?
text.completion: 这是什麽?要是我没猜错，这个火焰应该是从奥格玛中心拿到的吧!它燃烧的热度反映出兽人和食人妖凶猛的内心。真是为我们的收集品画龙点睛 - 从敌人的巢穴中偷取神圣的火焰，你真勇敢!$B$B不晓得其他城市里潜伏着什麽样的力量……$B$B

english.title: Stealing Orgrimmar's Flame
english.objectives: Return the Flame of Orgrimmar to the Festival Loremaster.
english.description: This flame, stolen from the heart of Orgrimmar itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
english.progress: You're practically glowing, $r. What do you have there?
english.completion: What's this? Unless I'm mistaken, this flame has been taken from the heart of Orgrimmar itself! The fierce hearts of the orcs and trolls are reflected in its searing heat. What a fine addition to our collection--how brave you are, stealing into the enemy's lair to retrieve the sacred flame! I wonder what power lurks in the other cities...

text.title: 盗取雷霆崖的烈焰
text.objectives: 将雷霆崖烈焰交给节日博学者。
text.description: 从雷霆崖萨满祭司身上偷来的烈焰令你感到异常的温暖。你对这种罕见的力量一无所知，但是博学者或许知道些什么……
text.progress: 你看起来很抢眼，$R。你带了什麽来?
text.completion: 除非我猜错了，否则这个火焰应该是从雷霆崖的悬崖边拿到的!听听它和精神力量的共鸣!你真是个厉害的小贼，$N。收下这个做为你的奖励。现在，如果我们能有全部三个城市的火焰……$B$B

english.title: Stealing Thunder Bluff's Flame
english.objectives: Return the Flame of Thunder Bluff to the Festival Loremaster.
english.description: This flame, stolen from the shaman of Thunder Bluff, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
english.progress: You're practically glowing, $r. What do you have there?
english.completion: Unless I miss my guess, this fire has been taken from the cliffs of Thunder Bluff! How it sings with the power of the spirits! You are quite the thief, $n. Take this as just payment for your skill. Now, if only we had the flames of all four cities...

text.title: 盗取幽暗城的烈焰
text.objectives: 将幽暗城烈焰交给节日博学者。
text.description: 从幽暗城上面的洛丹伦废墟偷来的烈焰令你感到异常的温暖。你对这种罕见的力量一无所知，但是博学者或许知道些什么……
text.progress: 你看起来很抢眼，$R。你带了什麽来?
text.completion: 嗯……真是把奇怪的火焰!它很柔和，几乎是无火苗的闷烧，但它的中心又很热切。你说你是从幽暗城取得它的吗?好极了。如果有了全部三个城市的火焰，谁知道我们能怎麽样?$B$B

english.title: Stealing the Undercity's Flame
english.objectives: Return the Flame of the Undercity to the Festival Loremaster.
english.description: This flame, stolen from the ruins above the Undercity, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
english.progress: You're practically glowing, $r. What do you have there?
english.completion: Hm... what a strange fire! It is subdued, nearly smoldering, but the heat is intense. And you received this from the Undercity, you say? Fascinating. With the flames of all four cities, who knows what we could accomplish?

text.title: 被遗忘者
text.objectives: 与塔奎林的高级执行官玛尔伦谈一谈。
text.description: 我知道被遗忘者出现在这儿很诡异，可他们确实是来帮忙的。跟高级执行官玛尔伦谈谈，他就在镇子西边的哨塔里。$B$B别忘了，$C，跟他谈完之后回到我这儿来，我还有件相当紧迫的艰巨任务要交给你去办！
text.completion: I know that we Forsaken appear monstrous to your eyes, but I assure you we mean your people no harm. We are here because of a common enemy: Dar'Khan the traitor! He has returned and now commands the Scourge that are invading this land from his steadfast, Deatholme, to the south. Our leader, Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, originally hails from these lands, and in fact used to be an elf. She has a history with Dar'Khan and wants him dead as much as your people do. We will defeat him together, $c!

english.title: The Forsaken
english.objectives: Speak with High Executor Mavren at Tranquillien in the Ghostlands.
english.description: I know it seems strange, but these Forsaken are here to help. You should speak with their leader, High Executor Mavren. He's in the tower on the west side of town.$B$BAnd, $c, when you're done talking with him return to me; I have something dire that needs to be dealt with immediately!
english.completion: I know that we Forsaken appear monstrous to your eyes, but I assure you we mean your people no harm. We are here because of a common enemy: Dar'Khan the traitor! He has returned and now commands the Scourge that are invading this land from his steadfast, Deatholme, to the south. Our leader, Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, originally hails from these lands, and in fact used to be an elf. She has a history with Dar'Khan and wants him dead as much as your people do. We will defeat him together, $c!

text.title: 辛多雷的英雄
text.objectives: 将达尔坎的徽记交给银月城的洛瑟玛·塞隆。
text.description: 这是我们血精灵一族的历史新篇章的开始，$N。我们将收复所有失地，并与希尔瓦娜斯和她的盟友紧密地连接在一起。$B$B将这个叛徒的徽记拿去交给银月城的摄政王洛瑟玛·塞隆。他一定是最渴望听到这个消息的人。
text.progress: You seek audience with me, $c?  I do not recall hearing of an appointment.
text.completion: Now that's one face I was not expecting to see so soon. This is quite the good news, $n, in more ways than you can imagine.

english.title: Hero of the Sin'dorei
english.objectives: Take Dar'Khan's Head to Lor'themar Theron in Silvermoon City.
english.description: This is the beginning of a new chapter in the history of our race, $N.  Our lands will be reclaimed and we shall cement our bond with Sylvanas and her allies.$B$BTake the traitor's head to Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron in Silvermoon City.  He'll be eager to hear the news.
english.progress: You seek audience with me, $c?  I do not recall hearing of an appointment.
english.completion: Now that's one face I was not expecting to see so soon. This is quite the good news, $n, in more ways than you can imagine.

text.title: 被遗忘者
text.objectives: 与塔奎林的高级执行官玛尔伦谈一谈。
text.description: I know it seems strange, but the Forsaken are here to help. You should speak with their leader, High Executor Mavren.  He's in the tower on the west side of town.$B$BAnd, $c, when you're done talking with him return to me; I have something dire that needs to be dealt with immediately!
text.completion: We Forsaken are here because of a common enemy with the blood elves: Dar'Khan!  He has returned and now commands the Scourge that are invading this land from his steadfast, Deatholme, to the south. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, who originally hails from these lands, and used to be an elf, has a history with Dar'Khan and wants him dead! We will defeat him, $c, and you will help us do it!

english.objectives: Speak with High Executor Mavren at Tranquillien in the Ghostlands.
english.description: I know it seems strange, but the Forsaken are here to help. You should speak with their leader, High Executor Mavren.  He's in the tower on the west side of town.$B$BAnd, $c, when you're done talking with him return to me; I have something dire that needs to be dealt with immediately!

He has returned and now commands the Scourge that are invading this land from his steadfast, Deatholme, to the south. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, who originally hails from these lands, and used to be an elf, has a history with Dar'Khan and wants him dead! We will defeat him, $c, and you will help us do it!

text.title: 盗取暴风城的烈焰
text.objectives: 将暴风城烈焰交给节日诗人。
text.description: 从暴风城中心偷来的烈焰令你感到异常的温暖。你对这种罕见的力量一无所知，但是诗人或许知道些什么……
text.progress: 你看起来很抢眼，$R。你带了什麽来?
text.completion: 这把烧地明亮的火焰……你说这是从暴风城来的?了不起!那一定是趟真正的冒险!当然，我会给你一点报酬。如果你又找到这样类似的东西，记得再来和我谈谈。$B$B

english.title: Stealing Stormwind's Flame
english.objectives: Return the Flame of Stormwind to the Festival Talespinner.
english.description: This flame, stolen from the heart of Stormwind itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
english.progress: You're practically glowing, $r. What do you have there?
english.completion: And this brightly-burning fire... you say it came from Stormwind? Remarkable! That must have been quite an adventure! I'll pay you for this, of course. If you find anything else like this, be sure to speak with me again.

text.title: 盗取铁炉堡的烈焰
text.objectives: 将铁炉堡烈焰交给节日诗人。
text.description: 从铁炉堡中心偷来的烈焰令你感到异常的温暖。你对这种罕见的力量一无所知，但是诗人或许知道些什么……
text.progress: 你看起来很抢眼，$R。你带了什麽来?
text.completion: 这个热烈的火焰一定是从铁炉堡的大厅来的;它和那些矮人一样坚定。做的好，$N。如果我有其他城市的火焰……啊，没事。这是你的酬劳。$B$B

english.title: Stealing Ironforge's Flame
english.objectives: Return the Flame of Ironforge to the Festival Talespinner.
english.description: This flame, stolen from the heart of Ironforge itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
english.progress: You're practically glowing, $r. What do you have there?
english.completion: This hearty flame must be from the halls of Ironforge; it's as stalwart as the dwarves themselves. A fine catch, $n. If I had the fires of the other cities... ah, but never mind. Here is your payment.

text.title: 盗取达纳苏斯的烈焰
text.objectives: 将达纳苏斯烈焰交给节日诗人。
text.description: 从泰达希尔海岸边偷来的烈焰令你感到异常的温暖。你对这种罕见的力量一无所知，但是诗人或许知道些什么……
text.progress: 你看起来很抢眼，$R。你带了什麽来?
text.completion: 这把火烧着古老的哀伤，$N。你说你是从泰达希尔根部拉出这个的吗?好极了!这是你努力的奖励。如果你找到任何像这样的东西就再来找我;我或许会有些用途。$B$B

english.title: Stealing Darnassus's Flame
english.objectives: Return the Flame of Darnassus to the Festival Talespinner.
english.description: This flame, stolen from the shores of Teldrassil, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
english.progress: You're practically glowing, $r. What do you have there?
english.completion: This fire aches of ancient sorrow, $n. You pulled this from the roots of Teldrassil, you say? Fascinating! Here is a reward for your skill. Return to me should you find anything else like this; I may have a use for it.

text.title: 银色黎明手套
text.completed: Return to Argent Outfitter.

english.completed: Return to Argent Quartermaster.

text.title: 塞纳里奥议会的盟友
text.progress: 即使你对我们提供的奖励没有兴趣，这些徽章仍象征着我们互相的信任和友谊。$B$B把它们带来给我。如果你的职责表现良好，我会做好应有的记录的。
text.completion: 你为我们带来荣耀，$N。有你持续的努力我们会克服所有障碍的。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Windcaller Kaldon in Silithus.

english.title: Allegiance to Cenarion Circle
english.completion: You honor us, $n.  With your continued efforts we will overcome all obstacles.
english.completed: Return to Windcaller Kaldon in Silithus.

text.title: 盗贼的奖励
text.objectives: Return the Flame of Stormwind to (NAME).
text.description: This flame, stolen from the heart of Stormwind itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the (NAME) might know more...
text.completion: 你今天已证明了自己的能力，$N。$B$B我没有什麽东西可给你，我只有这个王冠;是个适合胜利者的礼物。愿它照亮你的路。$B$B

english.title: A Thief's Reward
english.objectives: Return the Flame of Stormwind to (NAME).
english.description: This flame, stolen from the heart of Stormwind itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the (NAME) might know more...

text.title: 大裂隙
text.objectives: 猎鹰岗哨的游侠队长维恩雷要你前往猎鹰岗哨以东的大裂隙，杀死8个石镰幼崽和3个石镰突击者。
text.description: 联盟的军队几乎包围了猎鹰岗哨，我们的处境相当危险。艾泽拉斯世界的血精灵朝圣者们蜂拥而至，我们必须修筑一条安全的路线，躲避敌人的窥探。$B$B我已经想好了解决此事的办法，那就是开辟一条穿越大裂隙的秘密通道。$B$B好吧，我知道那儿盘踞着凶猛的剥石者，可它们只是一群野兽而已。给它们点教训，它们就不敢滋扰我们了。我要你前往大裂隙猎杀这些家伙，让它们知道我们的厉害。
text.completion: Good job, $n.  That should teach the rock flayers to stay far away from us.
text.completed: Return to Ranger Captain Venn'ren at Falcon Watch in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: The Great Fissure
english.objectives: Ranger Captain Venn'ren at Falcon Watch wants you to slay 8 Stonescythe Whelps and 3 Stonescythe Alphas at the Great Fissure, east of Falcon Watch.
english.description: We're dangerously close to becoming fenced in by Alliance forces.  With the influx of sin'dorei pilgrims from Azeroth, we must establish a route that's safe from our enemies' prying eyes.$B$BI've given it some thought and have arrived at a solution.  We're to establish a secret path through the Great Fissure.$B$BYes, even though the area is crawling with brutal rock flayers, they are merely beasts and can be taught to fear us.  I want you to go and kill a good number of them.  They shall learn fear.
english.completion: Good job, $n.  That should teach the rock flayers to stay far away from us.
english.completed: Return to Ranger Captain Venn'ren at Falcon Watch in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 银色黎明战袍
text.completed: Return to Argent Quartermaster.

english.title: Tabard of the Argent Dawn
english.completed: Return to Argent Quartermaster.

text.title: Marauding Crust Bursters
text.objectives: Foreman Razelcraz at the mines near Thrallmar wants you to kill 15 Marauding Crust Bursters. The worms have a tendency to attack suddenly from their tunnels below ground.
text.description: As if the gan'arg that overran the mines aren't bad enough, now we've got gigantic worms encroaching on us from the other direction!$B$BWith Thrallmar's garrison pinned down defending against the Legion and tending to their wounded, it leaves me and the miners to deal with the problems.$B$B<The foreman gestures at the sleeping peons.>$B$BAnd you can see how useful they are...$B$BI'd gladly pay you their wages to clear out some of those worms.
text.completed: Return to Foreman Razelcraz at Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.completed: Return to Argent Outfitter.

text.title: A Hasty Departure
text.objectives: Far Seer Regulkut wants you to track down her student Grelag.
text.description: Greetings, $N. Outland is a perilous place, as many of our expedition quickly learned. I'm afraid young Grelag may have learned that lesson firsthand.$B$BGrelag is a promising student, but he lacks patience! He eagerly studies the history of his people, but he sometimes forgets the threats of the present day.$B$BHe departed for the Spinebreaker Post, ignorant of the Legion and fel orc presences. I fear something may have happened to him.

english.title: A Hasty Departure
english.objectives: Far Seer Regulkut wants you to track down her student Grelag.

I'm afraid young Grelag may have learned that lesson firsthand.$B$BGrelag is a promising student, but he lacks patience! He eagerly studies the history of his people, but he sometimes forgets the threats of the present day.$B$BHe departed for the Spinebreaker Post, ignorant of the Legion and fel orc presences. I fear something may have happened to him.

text.title: 准备药膏
text.objectives: 将制作药膏所需的12片地狱火刺叶交给断背岗哨的葛雷拉格。
text.description: 在我试图进入塞斯高的时候，一名燃烧军团的巡逻兵发现了我。我拼命地逃，想躲进不远处的那些塔里去，可是他们放出了地狱猎犬，扑倒了我，几乎差点把我弄成残废！$B$B后来，我挣扎着逃到了这里，不过我的一条腿已经严重骨折了。石头守卫安比兰发现我之后，把我带到了这里。$B现在，我必须先想办法医治好这条腿。北边白骨之谷那里生长着一种刺叶植物，用它制成的药膏应该能够缓解我的伤痛，让我痊愈。
text.progress: Have you brought the plants?
text.completion: These should do the job. I'm going to prepare the salve and finish my splint before making my way back to Thrallmar. Why do I have the feeling that I know what Far Seer Regulkut will say when she sees me? Thank you for your help, $n. I have some of the spineleaf left over. You're welcome to take it with you. Who can tell when it will prove useful?
text.completed: Return to Grelag at Spinebreaker Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Preparing the Salve
english.objectives: Gather 12 Hellfire Spineleaf plants for a salve and return to Grelag at Spinebreaker Post.
english.description: Just as Zeth'Gor came into view, a Legion patrol caught sight of me. I ran, hoping to duck into one of the towers in the distance, but one of their felhounds caught up with me and nearly hamstrung me!$B$BI managed to escape, but my leg is in terrible shape. Stone Guard Ambelan found me and brought me here.$BNow, I have to find a way to tend to my leg. Spineleaf grows in and around the Valley of Bones to the north . A salve made from it will dull the pain enough for me to travel.
english.progress: Have you brought the plants?
english.completion: These should do the job. I'm going to prepare the salve and finish my splint before making my way back to Thrallmar. Why do I have the feeling that I know what Far Seer Regulkut will say when she sees me? Thank you for your help, $n. I have some of the spineleaf left over. You're welcome to take it with you. Who can tell when it will prove useful?
english.completed: Return to Grelag at Spinebreaker Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: When Helboars Fly
text.objectives: Watch Commander Krunk in Thrallmar wants you to bring him 10 Plump Helboar Carcasses from Starving Helboars.
text.description: Have you ever seen a helboar fly? They don't even need wings!$B$B<Watch Commander Krunk laughs.>$B$BThe fight against the Legion camps to the north has depleted our supplies, including catapult ammunition. This is the perfect opportunity to try something new.$B$BInstead of using boulders, I want to try igniting the corpses of the starving helboars I've seen around the eastern ruins and use them to bombard the Legion's camps.$B$BAre you going to volunteer, or do I have to order you?
text.completed: Return to Watch Commander Krunk at Stonewall Canyon in Hellfire Peninsula.
