english.completed: Return to Watch Commander Krunk at Stonewall Canyon in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 疯狂的虚空行者
text.objectives: Bring the Pulsating Voidwalker Essence to Mahuram Stouthoof in Thrallmar.
text.description: Examining the essence reveals violent swirls of energy sealed within a vessel made of unidentifiable material. As you consider it, you can feel it beginning to tug at your mind, inviting you to come closer and to look deeper.$B$BFeeling your will begin to slip away, you break your gaze immediately. Its presence remains at the edge of your consciousness as you determine what to do with it.

english.title: Voidwalkers Gone Wild
english.objectives: Bring the Pulsating Voidwalker Essence to Mahuram Stouthoof in Thrallmar.
english.description: Examining the essence reveals violent swirls of energy sealed within a vessel made of unidentifiable material. As you consider it, you can feel it beginning to tug at your mind, inviting you to come closer and to look deeper.$B$BFeeling your will begin to slip away, you break your gaze immediately. Its presence remains at the edge of your consciousness as you determine what to do with it.

text.title: Ravager Roundup
text.objectives: Slay 10 Captive Ravager Hatchlings and retrieve 12 Ravager Eggs for Mahuram Stouthoof in Thrallmar.
text.description: Outland is rife with fascinating creatures. Fascinating -- and extremely dangerous.$B$BThe area is rich with predators, which seems strange for such a barren land, but a closer look reveals something of a hierarchy.$B$BThe rock flayers seem to have domesticated another predator, the ravager, and breed them as hunting companions and guard animals. I need to know more about how they're training these ravagers. We must shut down and examine their breeding site to the southwest, near the Terokkar Forest.
text.completed: Return to Mahuram Stouthoof at Sha'naari Wastes in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Ravager Roundup
english.objectives: Slay 10 Captive Ravager Hatchlings and retrieve 12 Ravager Eggs for Mahuram Stouthoof in Thrallmar.
english.description: Outland is rife with fascinating creatures. Fascinating -- and extremely dangerous.$B$BThe area is rich with predators, which seems strange for such a barren land, but a closer look reveals something of a hierarchy.$B$BThe rock flayers seem to have domesticated another predator, the ravager, and breed them as hunting companions and guard animals. I need to know more about how they're training these ravagers. We must shut down and examine their breeding site to the southwest, near the Terokkar Forest.
english.completed: Return to Mahuram Stouthoof at Sha'naari Wastes in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 掠食者的卵
text.objectives: 将12枚饥饿掠食者的卵交给地狱火半岛飞艇坠毁点的雷加希。
text.description: 哦哦……我快要饿死了！$B$B嘿，朋友，你是不是觉得很讽刺？厨师快被活活饿死了？$B$B<雷加希干笑两声，从口袋中掏出一张褶皱的羊皮纸，并慢慢展开。>$B$B根据我们的旅游地图，我们的飞艇被搞下来之前是要飞去西南边靠近泰罗卡森林的一个叫荆刺小径的地方。据说那里盛产掠食者的卵，无比美味！如果你够胆去那里帮我弄些这种蛋回来的话，我就能做顿大餐了！前菜是蛋黄沙拉配蛋花汤，主菜是芥末煎蛋卷配蛋炒饭，甜点是蛋挞，唔，听起来好象有点扯蛋……
text.progress: You have those eggs yet?
text.completion: In order to have great cuisine, you need to have great ingredients.  And these eggs look great! I've just finished cleaning off my frying pan, so you're more than welcome to join me for a meal!
text.completed: Return to Legassi at at the Zeppelin Crash in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Ravager Egg Roundup
english.objectives: Retrieve 12 Ravager Eggs for Legassi at the Zeppelin Crash in Hellfire Peninsula.
english.description: I'm starving!$B$BThere's irony in that, wouldn't you say?  A starving cook?$B$B<Legassi laughs half-heartedly and taps a folded piece of parchment he has in his pocket.>$B$BAccording to this tourist map we were following - before we were so rudely shot down - there's an area to the southwest, near Terokkar Forest.  It's called the Razorthorn Trail, and supposedly it's brimming with delicious ravager eggs!$B$BI could cook up quite a feast if only someone were brave enough to go down there and get me some!
english.progress: You have those eggs yet?
english.completion: In order to have great cuisine, you need to have great ingredients.  And these eggs look great! I've just finished cleaning off my frying pan, so you're more than welcome to join me for a meal!
english.completed: Return to Legassi at at the Zeppelin Crash in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: A Peon's Work is Never Done
text.objectives: Gather 8 Clefthoof Hides and 8 sets of Clefthoof Bones from the Raging Clefthoof. Return to Watch Commander Krunk in Thrallmar once you have all the materials.
text.description: The Legion's constant assaults take a heavy toll on our defenses. If the palisade falls, so will Thrallmar. I've assigned peons to reinforce and repair the walls, but we're running out of materials.$B$BGrelag, one of the Far Seer's students, is well versed in the old ways and suggested returning to an ancient practice. Long ago, the clefthoof hunt supplied us with meat, hides, and bones. Taking up the hunt again, with the clefthoof to the southeast, would provide what's needed and honor the ancestors.
text.completed: Return to Watch Commander Krunk at Stonewall Canyon in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: A Peon's Work is Never Done
english.objectives: Gather 8 Clefthoof Hides and 8 sets of Clefthoof Bones from the Raging Clefthoof. Return to Watch Commander Krunk in Thrallmar once you have all the materials.
english.description: The Legion's constant assaults take a heavy toll on our defenses. If the palisade falls, so will Thrallmar. I've assigned peons to reinforce and repair the walls, but we're running out of materials.$B$BGrelag, one of the Far Seer's students, is well versed in the old ways and suggested returning to an ancient practice. Long ago, the clefthoof hunt supplied us with meat, hides, and bones. Taking up the hunt again, with the clefthoof to the southeast, would provide what's needed and honor the ancestors.
english.completed: Return to Watch Commander Krunk at Stonewall Canyon in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 疯狂的虚空行者
text.objectives: 将10份浓缩的虚空行者精华交给飞艇坠毁点的“尖嗓子”斯克里·拉克希德。
text.description: 虽然飞艇的机身已经修好了，但我还得找一些能烧的东西来发动引擎。我们的燃料全部用完了，在这个地方又搞不到新的燃料！$B$B在我们的正南面有个叫迁跃平原的地方，那里有许多失去控制的、凶猛的虚空行者。不过在我看来，那就是一群活蹦乱跳活泼可爱的活电池。$B$B如果你能帮我搞到些它们的精华，我就可以将飞艇的引擎改为由它们驱动的装置，说不定能比以前飞得更远哩！
text.progress: Were you able to get the essence?
text.completion: This is perfect! In fact, I think it's going to work so well, I might just have to redesign the engine to take advantage of all this extra power. If, I mean, when we get out of here, I'll have to show my design to everyone back at Area 52!
text.completed: Return to "Screaming" Screed Luckheed at the Zeppelin Crash in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Voidwalkers Gone Wild
english.objectives: Bring 10 Condensed Voidwalker Essences to "Screaming" Screed Luckheed at the Zeppelin Crash.
english.description: Even if I can get the zeppelin's frame repaired, I'll have to find something else to power the engine. I'm all out of fuel and there's no place to fill up around here!$B$BTo the south of us is an area of broken land called the Warp Fields. It's full of rogue and uncontrolled voidwalkers, but I like to think of them as walking batteries.$B$BIf you can bring me enough of their essence, I can convert the zeppelin's engine to run on it. Five gold says I'll even get better mileage out of it, too!
english.progress: Were you able to get the essence?
english.completion: This is perfect! In fact, I think it's going to work so well, I might just have to redesign the engine to take advantage of all this extra power. If, I mean, when we get out of here, I'll have to show my design to everyone back at Area 52!
english.completed: Return to "Screaming" Screed Luckheed at the Zeppelin Crash in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 达纳苏斯的侵扰
text.objectives: 前往鹰翼广场西南方的西部圣殿击败在那一带出现的入侵者，然后将你发现的情况汇报给魔网监护者薇兰妮亚。
text.description: 我除了时刻警惕失心者滋扰生事之外，还要处理一堆声称看到暗夜精灵的虚假情报。$B$B虽然事实证明大多数情报都是子虚乌有，但是有件事倒是值得深入调查下。最近，我们的主要能源供给站西部圣殿遭到了严重破坏，传言都说是达纳苏斯的暗夜精灵干的。$B$B去那儿看看有没有可疑的家伙出没。然后向驻守在西部圣殿的魔网监护者薇兰妮亚汇报情况。
text.completion: Night elves?  Here?  Those rats! Do you suppose they had anything to do with the malfunction in my sanctum?  If you have any information, you'd better take it to Captain Sunbrand at once!
text.completed: Return to Ley-Keeper Velania at the West Sanctum in Eversong Woods.

english.title: Darnassian Intrusions
english.objectives: Travel to the West Sanctum, southwest of Falconwing Square and defeat any intruders present there.  Report your findings to Ley-Keeper Velania.
english.description: Besides the constant threat that the Wretched represent, I also have to deal with all kind of fictitious reports of night elf sightings.$B$BThough most reports are unfounded, one recent incident demands further investigation.  The West Sanctum, one of our primary energy sources, has suffered a terrible malfunction and rumors of Darnassian sabotage are rampant.$B$BTravel there and deal with anyone that looks suspicious.  Report back to Ley-Keeper Velania, who watches over the sanctum.
english.completion: Night elves?  Here?  Those rats! Do you suppose they had anything to do with the malfunction in my sanctum?  If you have any information, you'd better take it to Captain Sunbrand at once!
english.completed: Return to Ley-Keeper Velania at the West Sanctum in Eversong Woods.

text.title: 可口可乐夏日礼包兑换券
text.completed: Return to She number two.

english.title: Redeem iCoke Gift Box Voucher
english.completed: Return to She number two.

text.title: 寻找新材料
text.objectives: 杀死一些暴怒的裂蹄牛，收集8张裂蹄牛的皮和8根裂蹄牛的肌腱，将它们交给荣耀堡的哈姆菲。
text.description: <正忙着做事的矮人见到你过来，立刻满是期待地抬起头。>$B$B你如果也想委托我制造装备的话，就排队等着吧，$C。我现在正忙着维修洛萨之子的盔甲呢，毕竟，没几天之后我们就得再次与敌人战斗了。$B$B自从那些该死的硬壳穿地虫侵占了矿井之后，我们的金属库存量就一直在下降，如今可是没剩多少了。我正在用从荣耀堡东北边那些暴怒的裂蹄牛身上收集到的材料做一些试验。虽然这些材料无法完全取代钢铁，但眼下我们也只能将就着用了。
text.completed: Return to Humphry in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Searching for New Materials
english.objectives: Gather 8 Clefthoof Hides and 8 Clefthoof Sinews from the Raging Clefthoof. When you have the materials, bring them to Humphry in Honor Hold.
english.description: <The dwarf looks up from his work expectantly.>$B$BIf you're looking to commission a piece, get in line, $c. I've got my hands full maintaining the Sons' equipment and preparing us for the day when we'll take the battle to the enemy again.$B$BOur metal stocks are getting very low since crust borers invaded the mines. I've been experimenting with natural materials from the raging clefthoof that graze in the areas northeast of the Hold, and while they're no substitute for iron, I'm learning to make do.
english.completed: Return to Humphry in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 聪明人的工作
text.objectives: 杀死15只游荡的硬壳穿地虫，然后向荣耀堡的工头比格姆斯复命。
text.description: 你好，$C。总算有援兵过来了，现在我们终于可以开始处理周边生物所造成的问题了！$B$B我们的首要目标是确保西南边的那条道路的交通安全，但现在那些该死的硬壳穿地虫在那里频繁出没，将路面也破坏得凌乱不堪。$B$B如果你愿意帮助我们解决那些可恶的家伙，洛萨之子将感激不尽。不过，你千万得小心，它们很敏感。
text.completion: Well done, $n. We shouldn't be too quick to congratulate ourselves, though. I'm certain we haven't seen the last of those worms. If they show their hideous heads around these parts again, the Sons'll be ready for them!
text.completed: Return to Foreman Biggums at Honor Hold Mine in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: A Job for an Intelligent Man
english.objectives: Kill 15 Marauding Crust Bursters and return to Foreman Biggums at Honor Hold.
english.description: Well met, $c. Now that reinforcements are finally arriving, we can recapture some semblance of a normal life.$B$BOne of our first goals is to restore the flow of men and goods along the road to the southwest, but it must be reclaimed from the crust bursters that've overrun the area.$B$BIf you're willing to help us deal with this menace, you would have the gratitude of the Sons. Watch carefully for the disturbed ground they leave in their wake.
english.completion: Well done, $n. We shouldn't be too quick to congratulate ourselves, though. I'm certain we haven't seen the last of those worms. If they show their hideous heads around these parts again, the Sons'll be ready for them!
english.completed: Return to Foreman Biggums at Honor Hold Mine in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 万无一失
text.objectives: 将12只强壮的秃鹫翅膀交给飞艇坠毁点的雷加希。
text.description: 斯克里总是喜欢夸自己的飞行技术“万无一失”，但我觉得这家伙好象随时能把飞艇开坠毁的样子！$B$B看看那边的残骸吧，那就是他某次成功的“紧急迫降”搞出来的。$B$B当然，那时候我们的确也遭到了敌人的攻击，但如果他能少吹嘘几句他的飞行技术，我就愿意原谅他！$B$B哦，对了，我想我得帮他搞点鸟翅来，这家伙说吃啥补啥，给他来点翅膀或许他的飞行技术也会好点。在东边的白骨之谷中，你可以看到许多啄骨秃鹰，它们的翅膀巨大多汁，最合适烧烤了。
text.progress: I can't wait to see the look on his face when he digs in. Ever since the crash, he's been complaining that all I can think of is food. Well, someone's got to feed us while he tinkers with the zeppelin!
text.completion: Ravager Eggs.  Bam! Hellboar Bacon. Bam! Buzzard Wings. Bam!  Bam! What a great meal.  You've really got to try it.
text.completed: Return to Legassi at the Zeppelin Crash in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Smooth as Butter
english.objectives: Bring 12 Plump Buzzard Wings to Legassi at the Zeppelin Crash.
english.description: Screed likes to say his flying is as "smooth as butter." I think "butterfingered" is more like it!$B$BTake a look at the wreckage over there. He calls it a "rough" landing.$B$BSure, we got shot at, but I'd be willing to cut him a little more slack if he didn't brag about his piloting skills so often!$B$BI think I'm going to make him a batch of wings to drive the point home. To the east, in the Valley of Bones, you'll find bonestripper buzzards. Their wings are plump, juicy, and perfect for my needs.
english.progress: I can't wait to see the look on his face when he digs in. Ever since the crash, he's been complaining that all I can think of is food. Well, someone's got to feed us while he tinkers with the zeppelin!
english.completion: Ravager Eggs.  Bam! Hellboar Bacon. Bam! Buzzard Wings. Bam!  Bam! What a great meal.  You've really got to try it.
english.completed: Return to Legassi at the Zeppelin Crash in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: Report to Aeldon Sunbrand
text.objectives: Report to Aeldon Sunbrand at the Inner Elf Gate in Eversong Woods.
text.description: If you're looking for work, you'll find Captain Sunbrand inside the Inner Elf Gate, through the doors behind me.$B$BNow leave me be, I must question this scoundrel.

english.title: Report to Aeldon Sunbrand
english.objectives: Report to Aeldon Sunbrand at the Inner Elf Gate in Eversong Woods.
english.description: If you're looking for work, you'll find Captain Sunbrand inside the Inner Elf Gate, through the doors behind me.$B$BNow leave me be, I must question this scoundrel.

text.title: 游侠萨蕾恩
text.objectives: 向永歌森林晴风村外的游侠萨蕾恩报到。
text.description: 别以为这座村庄很安全，天灾士兵和失心者经常分别从东西两侧对我们发动进攻。$B$B游侠萨蕾恩负责保卫边界的安全，防止天灾士兵从死亡之痕攻入。沿着东边的道路离开村子，看看你能否帮她一把。
text.completion: You're here to help us?  Why didn't you say so earlier?  We can always use a hand!

english.title: Ranger Sareyn
english.objectives: Report to Ranger Sareyn outside Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.
english.description: Don't take the safety of this village for granted.  We're under siege by the Scourge on the east and the Wretched to the west.$B$BRanger Sareyn keeps our borders safe from the undead that pour in from the Dead Scar.  Follow the road eastwards out of town and see if you can lend her a hand.
english.completion: You're here to help us?  Why didn't you say so earlier?  We can always use a hand!

text.title: 远行者居所
text.objectives: 向永歌森林远行者营地的达恩·晨行者中尉报告。
text.description: 你在我们与失心者的战斗中提供了非常重要的帮助，而正在与阿曼尼巨魔战斗的远行者们也应该会需要你这样勇敢的$C的帮助。$B$B去东北边的远行者居所，和达恩·晨行者谈谈，看看她需要你帮什么忙。
text.completion: You're here to help?  Excellent! The battle against the Amani trolls has taken its toll on us and capable fighters such as yourself are always welcome.

english.title: Farstrider Retreat
english.objectives: Report to Lieutenant Dawnrunner at the Farstrider Retreat in Eversong Woods.
english.description: Your help in subduing the Wretched has been invaluable.  The Farstriders would surely have use for someone like you in their fight against the Amani trolls.$B$BLook for the Farstrider Retreat to the northeast of here, speak to Lieutenant Dawnrunner and see what assistance she might need.
english.completion: You're here to help?  Excellent! The battle against the Amani trolls has taken its toll on us and capable fighters such as yourself are always welcome.

text.title: 阿曼尼的入侵
text.objectives: 将阿曼尼入侵计划交给远行者居所的达恩·晨行者中尉。
text.description: 虽然你看不懂作战计划书中的文字，但是你发现有幅地图上清晰地标示着远行者居所和晴风村的位置。$B$B最好把这一情况汇报给远行者居所的达恩·晨行者中尉。
text.progress: What do you want to show me?
text.completion: The trolls have been keeping us pinned here while planning an attack on Fairbreeze Village.  We were not expecting this at all.

english.title: Amani Invasion
english.objectives: Deliver the Amani Invasion Plans to Lieutenant Dawnrunner at Farstrider Retreat.
english.description: Though you don't understand the language in these battle plans, you clearly make out a map marking the positions of the Farstrider Retreat and Fairbreeze Village.$B$BYou'd best let Lieutenant Dawnrunner at the Farstrider Retreat know about this.
english.progress: What do you want to show me?
english.completion: The trolls have been keeping us pinned here while planning an attack on Fairbreeze Village.  We were not expecting this at all.

text.title: 地狱野猪，另一种白肉
text.objectives: 飞艇坠毁点的雷加希要你收集8块纯净的地狱野猪肉。你必须首先猎杀地狱野猪，然后利用净化药剂来净化被污染的地狱野猪肉。
text.description: 这些蛋好极了，但为什么我们不再来点别的呢？$B$B加上一些熏肉会让这顿大餐更加完美，而且，我知道在哪里能弄到熏肉。$B$B你看，这片区域到处都有地狱野猪，而且这里没有人去检查它们的肉是否能够食用，也没有人会烹饪那些肉。不过我们非常幸运！$B$B<雷加希在背包里仔细翻找，拿出了一个小瓶子。>$B$B这个虽然不是专为猪肉所准备的，不过，你要知道，烹饪需要创意！
text.progress: Were you successful in purifying the helboar meat?
text.completion: Hmm... This looks edible, if spiced properly. Just don't tell Screed where his breakfast came from, ok?
text.completed: Return to Legassi at the Zeppelin Crash in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Helboar, the Other White Meat
english.objectives: Legassi at the Zeppelin Crash wants you to gather 8 Purified Helboar Meat. To purify the meat, use the Purification Mixture on the Tainted Helboar Meat you gather from Helboars.
english.description: Those eggs are superb, but what do you say we kick it up another notch?$B$BA side of bacon would round out the meal perfectly and I know just where to get it.$B$BThis place is littered with helboars. Of course, there's no one here to inspect and tenderize the meat, but we're in luck!$B$B<Legassi rummages around in his pack and produces a flask.>$B$BThis wasn't made for use on pork, but cooking is as much about improvisation as anything else!
english.progress: Were you successful in purifying the helboar meat?
english.completion: Hmm... This looks edible, if spiced properly. Just don't tell Screed where his breakfast came from, ok?
english.completed: Return to Legassi at the Zeppelin Crash in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 军阀克雷利安
text.objectives: 为大法师克希雷姆夺回虹彩贝壳。大法师克希雷姆就居住在艾萨拉北部悬崖上的一座塔中。
text.description: 没什么时间了，$N！我的探知法术最近发现了一个很强大的法术源。但我却不能离开法师塔，所以只有请你帮我杀死那个占有这件神器的邪恶生物。$B$B这个邪恶的家伙名叫军阀克雷利安，他躲藏在守卫森严的辛玛洛神殿。把他烧成灰，然后将他垂涎已久的虹彩贝壳给我带回来。
text.progress: 没有时间可以浪费了!你拿到贝壳了吗?
text.completion: 我必须说，这个贝壳有一种奇怪的光环。看来要奖励你取得它的一部分报酬就是派你去测试它的魔法潜力……$B$B
text.completed: Return to Archmage Xylem at Bear's Head in Azshara.

english.title: Warlord Krellian
english.objectives: Retrieve the Prismatic Shell for Archmage Xylem.  The Archmage resides in a tower atop the cliffs of Azshara.
english.description: There isn't much time, $n!  My scrying spells have revealed a powerful source of magic.  I cannot leave the tower, and would ask you to kill the vile creature in possession of this artifact.$b$bThe pathetic little cretin is known as Warlord Krellian, hiding behind his guards in the Temple of Zin-Malor.  Burn him to ashes and take the prismatic shell he covets so dearly.
english.progress: There is not time to waste!  Have you the shell?
english.completion: I must say, this shell has a strange aura.  It seems only fitting that part of your reward for retrieving it would be to test its magical capabilities...
english.completed: Return to Archmage Xylem at Bear's Head in Azshara.

text.title: 警告晴风村
text.objectives: 与永歌森林晴风村的游侠戴戈利恩谈一谈。
text.description: 将阿曼尼巨魔的计划告知晴风村的游侠戴戈利恩。虽然祖玛洛什已死，晴风村还是要做好充足的准备。告诉戴戈利恩我会尽快派去援军的。
text.completion: The information you've brought is of vital importance, $n.  Now that we know of the trolls' plans we can prepare for an attack. We won't be caught with our guard down.

english.title: Warning Fairbreeze Village
english.objectives: Travel to Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods and speak to Ranger Degolien.
english.description: Go to Fairbreeze Village and notify Ranger Degolien of the Amani plans.  Even with Zul'Marosh dead, Fairbreeze must prepare for a troll attack.  Tell Degolien I will send him reinforcements as soon as possible.
english.completion: The information you've brought is of vital importance, $n.  Now that we know of the trolls' plans we can prepare for an attack. We won't be caught with our guard down.

text.title: 魔法的碎片
text.objectives: 对艾萨拉的恶鞭纳迦使用变形术，然后杀死几秒钟后出现的相似体。当你杀了50个相似体后，回去向大法师克希雷姆复命。
text.description: 我的研究发现了这个虹彩贝壳的一个特殊用途。$B$B带上这个贝壳，到艾萨拉四处找一些恶鞭纳迦，使用一下变形术看看。如果你愿意等一段时间，那么这个贝壳上所附带的光环会使他们分裂为几个小一些的相似物体。尽快杀死这些物体，贝壳就可以收集它们的精华。$B$B等贝壳满了之后，回来找我。
text.progress: 你收集到那些魔法了吗?
text.completion: 太棒了!太棒了!$B$B现在我们就可以重新将这魔法组成新的法术。看啊!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Archmage Xylem at Bear's Head in Azshara.

english.title: Fragmented Magic
english.objectives: Polymorph the Spitelash of Azshara and kill the clones that appear several seconds later.  When you have slain 50 Polymorph Clones, return to Archmage Xylem in Azshara.
english.description: My research has revealed a unique purpose for the prismatic shell.$b$bCarry the shell and cast your polymorph spell on the Spitelash in Azshara.  If you wait a few moments, the chaotic aura of the shell will cause them to split into several smaller clones for a few moments.  Kill these clones as quickly as possible, and the shell will collect their essence.$b$bWhen the shell is full, return it to me.
english.progress: Have you collected the magic?
english.completion: Splendid!  Splendid! Now we are able to reform this magic into a new spell.  Behold!
english.completed: Return to Archmage Xylem at Bear's Head in Azshara.

text.title: 盗贼的奖励
text.objectives: Return the Flame of Stormwind to (NAME).
text.description: This flame, stolen from the heart of Stormwind itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the (NAME) might know more...
text.completion: 你今天已证明了自己的能力，$N。$B$B我没有什麽东西可给你，我只有这个王冠;是个适合胜利者的礼物。愿它照亮你的路。$B$B

english.title: A Thief's Reward
english.objectives: Return the Flame of Stormwind to (NAME).
english.description: This flame, stolen from the heart of Stormwind itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the (NAME) might know more...

text.title: 邪恶之血
text.objectives: 猎鹰岗哨的阴沉的利亚森要你前往阿苟纳之池，从恐惧魔身上收集6份邪血样本。
text.description: 此地东北方的阿苟纳之池曾是德莱尼人的圣地，恶魔阿苟纳的血液洒入池水后，整片区域都被污染了。$B$B虽然事隔多时，被稀释的恶魔之血仍然蕴涵着强大的力量。盘踞在那儿的恐惧魔也拥有了阿苟纳血液中的邪恶力量。杀死他们，替我取回一些邪恶样本。我不会让你白忙活的。
text.progress: The felblood... did you obtain it, $n?
text.completion: The energy contained in these samples is tremendous, $n.  Now we just need to ensure that our access to this felblood continues uninterrupted.
text.completed: Return to Ryathen the Somber at Falcon Watch in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: In Need of Felblood
english.objectives: Ryathen the Somber at Falcon Watch in Hellfire Peninsula wants you to bring him 6 Felblood Samples from the Terrorfiends that inhabit the Pools of Aggonar.
english.description: Northeast of here lie the Pools of Aggonar.  Once a sacred site to the draenei, their waters were corrupted after the blood from the demon Aggonar was spilled into them.$B$BThat blood, though old and diluted, still possesses tremendous power.  Terrorfiends now walk the area, empowered by the pure demonic energies of the original blood.  Slay them and retrieve as much felblood as you can.  I'll make it worth your while.
english.progress: The felblood... did you obtain it, $n?
english.completion: The energy contained in these samples is tremendous, $n.  Now we just need to ensure that our access to this felblood continues uninterrupted.
english.completed: Return to Ryathen the Somber at Falcon Watch in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 火焰的节日
text.objectives: 碰触暴风城、铁炉堡和达纳苏斯城里的篝火，然后与城市内的节日博学者交谈。
text.description: 仲夏就要来了！$B$B每一年，按照传统，各大城市里都会选出护火者来照看我们城中的篝火。当火焰燃烧在艾泽拉斯世界的各处时，我们就可以通过这种世上最热诚也最明亮的事物向夏天这个季节表示敬意。$B$B事实上，若你不介意的话，我有个任务要交给你。我还不知道是否所有城市里的火焰都已经点起了。到各大城市去吧，让那里的火焰温暖你的身躯，当然，首先要确认它们已经被点燃了！
text.progress: 火焰都发烫着吗?
text.completion: 太好了!如果那些营火真的如你们所说的那样炽热的燃烧着，看来我们今年指派的火焰管理者都很尽责。谢谢你帮我去调查;来，收下这个做为我一点小意思。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Festival Loremaster.

english.title: The Festival of Fire
english.objectives: Touch the bonfires within Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus, then speak to a Festival Loremaster within the capital cities.
english.description: Midsummer is upon us once again!$b$bEach year, as tradition dictates, Flamekeepers are chosen to tend the bonfires within our capitals. While fires are burning throughout Azeroth, it is imperative that ours be the hottest and brightest, to properly pay homage to the season.$b$bIn fact, I have a task for you, if you don't mind. I've not yet heard if the fires in all capitals are properly burning. Travel there yourself and warm yourself by the fires--make sure they're hot!
english.completed: Return to Festival Loremaster.

text.title: 火焰的节日
text.objectives: 碰触奥格瑞玛、雷霆崖和幽暗城里的篝火，然后与城市内的节日诗人交谈。
text.description: 仲夏就要来了！$B$B每一年，按照传统，各大城市里都会选出护火者来照看我们城中的篝火。当火焰燃烧在艾泽拉斯世界的各处时，我们就可以通过这种世上最热诚也最明亮的事物向夏天这个季节表示敬意。$B$B事实上，若你不介意的话，我有个任务要交给你。我还不知道是否所有城市里的火焰都已经点起了。到各大城市去吧，让那里的火焰温暖你的身躯，当然，首先要确认它们已经被点燃了！
text.progress: 进度如何了，$N?
text.completion: 太好了!如果那些营火真的如你们所说的那样炽热的燃烧着，看来我们今年指派的火焰管理者都很尽责。谢谢你帮我去调查;来，收下这个做为我一点小意思。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Festival Talespinner.

english.title: The Festival of Fire
english.objectives: Touch the bonfires within Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, and the Undercity, then speak to a Festival Talespinner within the capital cities.
english.description: Midsummer is upon us once again!$b$bEach year, as tradition dictates, Flamekeepers are chosen to tend the bonfires within our capitals. While fires are burning throughout Azeroth, it is imperative that ours be the hottest and brightest, to properly pay homage to the season.$b$bIn fact, I have a task for you, if you don't mind. I've not yet heard if the fires in all capitals are properly burning. Travel there yourself and warm yourself by the fires--make sure they're hot!
english.completed: Return to Festival Talespinner.

text.title: 补充治疗水晶
text.objectives: Acquire 6 Vials of Moth Blood from the nearby Vale Moths and bring them to Proenitus at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
text.description: 我们是德莱尼人。许多族人在飞船坠毁时身负重伤，亟待医治，可是治疗水晶已经所剩不多了。我们必须迅速补充库存！$B$B眼下这种窘迫的局面，也只能用峡谷蛾的血液作为治疗水晶的替代品。$B$B峡谷蛾随处可见，不过它们大多分布在西北边。
text.progress: Have you harvested the necessary moth blood for the healing crystals yet?  With survivors scattered all over the vale, time is of the essence!
text.completion: Regrettable that those creatures had to die so that we might live - indiscriminate killing is not the draenei way.  However, the blood you gathered will replenish our healing crystals, so their deaths will not be in vain.
text.completed: Return to Proenitus at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

english.title: Replenishing the Healing Crystals
english.objectives: Acquire 6 Vials of Moth Blood from the nearby Vale Moths and bring them to Proenitus at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
english.description: We are the draenei.  Our ship crashed and, since we have many wounded, our immediate concern is the depleted state of our healing crystals.  We must replenish them quickly!$B$BUnfortunately, the only way to do this at this point is to extract the blood from the local vale moths.  Their blood will make for a suitable substitute.$B$BThe moths can be found in many places around the vale, but mostly in the northwest.
english.progress: Have you harvested the necessary moth blood for the healing crystals yet?  With survivors scattered all over the vale, time is of the essence!
english.completion: Regrettable that those creatures had to die so that we might live - indiscriminate killing is not the draenei way.  However, the blood you gathered will replenish our healing crystals, so their deaths will not be in vain.
english.completed: Return to Proenitus at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

text.title: 阻止净化
text.objectives: 前往阿苟纳之池，将信号宝石放置在阿苟纳祭坛附近，击败被召唤出来的德莱尼学者。完成任务后返回猎鹰岗哨，将信号宝石交还给阴沉的利亚森。
text.description: 我们的斥候在阿苟纳之池俘获了一名德莱尼圣骑士。当时他正在操办某种净化仪式，看来德莱尼人企图净化阿苟纳之池。我们必须阻止他们，否则邪血样本的来源就会被切断！$B$B我们从圣骑士身上搜出一枚信号宝石，这东西似乎是用来标记安全地点的，这样那些自称为“学者”的德莱尼牧师就知道该在哪里启动净化仪式了。将这颗宝石放置在阿苟纳祭坛附近，击败靠近它的德莱尼人。$B$B我建议你最好带上一两个朋友。
text.progress: You've returned, $n.  Did you put an end to the draenei's folly?
text.completion: That'll show those holy fanatics to mind their own business.
text.completed: Return to Ryathen the Somber at Falcon Watch in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: The Cleansing Must Be Stopped
english.objectives: Place the Signaling Gem near the Altar of Aggonar at the Pools of Aggonar and defeat any Draenei Anchorites that respond to your summons.  Return to Ryathen the Somber at Falcon Watch with the Signaling Gem after completing this task.
english.description: Our scouts captured a draenei paladin at the Pools of Aggonar.  He was to take part in a cleansing ritual to purify the pools.  We must stop the draenei from succeeding or we will lose our supply of felblood!$B$BHe was carrying this signaling gem, looking to mark a spot where a priest - or "anchorite" as they call themselves - could perform their rituals in safety.  Place the gem near the Altar of Aggonar and be ready to ambush any approaching draenei.$B$BI suggest that you take a friend or two along.
english.progress: You've returned, $n.  Did you put an end to the draenei's folly?
english.completion: That'll show those holy fanatics to mind their own business.
english.completed: Return to Ryathen the Somber at Falcon Watch in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 植物学家塔蕾克丝
text.objectives: 与埃门谷坠毁点的植物学家塔蕾克丝谈一谈。
text.description: $N，植物学家塔蕾克丝需要帮助。她和她的学徒们在西边，就在飞船外。
text.completion: Oh, thank goodness you've come.  We have much to do.

english.title: Botanist Taerix
english.objectives: Speak with Botanist Taerix at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
english.description: $N, Botanist Taerix is in need of your assistance. You'll find her with her apprentices to the west, outside the ship.
english.completion: Oh, thank goodness you've come.  We have much to do.

text.title: 恶魔的玷污
text.objectives: 地狱火半岛塞纳里奥哨站的塞安·红鬃要你从笨拙的地狱野猪身上收集6份地狱野猪血样。
text.description: 欢迎来到塞纳里奥哨站，$C。我们很少结交外面的朋友，不过，依然很高兴见到你。为了研究这个破碎世界中的生物与生态，我常常会前往许多偏远的角落。$B$B不过，上一次塞纳里奥远征队派我去研究外域中最危险的野生生物时，我却发现了一件惊人的事情。当这里的许多生物遭受辐射之后，它们的身体都发生了可怕的变异。目前，我正在收集血样，试图研究这些变异。如果你愿意帮忙的话，我会非常感激你的。
text.progress: Were you able to collect the blood samples?
text.completion: Well done, $n. These blood samples will prove helpful in my research and in the Expedition's wider studies of Outland's creatures. If I could isolate what causes these creatures to change continuously, perhaps I could concoct an antidote.
text.completed: Return to Thiah Redmane at the Cenarion Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Demonic Contamination
english.objectives: Thiah Redmane, at the Cenarion Post in Hellfire Peninsula, has asked you to gather 6 Helboar Blood Samples from Hulking Helboars.
english.description: Welcome to the Cenarion Post, $c. We don't often get company out here, but I'm grateful for the visit. My work with the creatures of this desolate land requires me to travel to many remote places.$B$BThe Cenarion Expedition has dispatched me to study some of the most dangerous wildlife in Outland, and I've made a startling discovery. While many creatures here have already undergone radical changes, they continue to mutate. I'm collecting blood samples to document the changes, and any help would be welcome.
english.progress: Were you able to collect the blood samples?
english.completion: Well done, $n. These blood samples will prove helpful in my research and in the Expedition's wider studies of Outland's creatures. If I could isolate what causes these creatures to change continuously, perhaps I could concoct an antidote.
english.completed: Return to Thiah Redmane at the Cenarion Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 遗失的信件
text.objectives: 前往地狱火半岛西部的沙纳尔废墟，将被腐蚀的皮箱交给驻扎在废墟附近的塞安·红鬃。
text.description: 仔细地察看过这只坏掉的皮箱子之后，你发现它很明显是遭到了那些虫子消化道内的腐蚀性液体的破坏。它表面的皮革似乎经过了一些简单的加工，但装饰与加工的细节已经无从辨认，也无法提供线索了。$B$B皮箱上唯一能看清楚的是一小块已经磨损很严重的塞纳里奥议会的标志。除此以外，你没有办法了解更多有关这个小皮箱的情况了。因此，你认为最好的处理方法就是将它交给一名塞纳奥议会的成员。
text.progress: Good day, $c. What brings you to my encampment?
text.completion: Thank you for bringing this to me, $c. I was wondering why I hadn't heard from the Expedition in so long. I wonder how long ago this message was dispatched and what befell its carrier. Here's a bit of coin for your trouble.

english.title: Missing Missive
english.objectives: Return the Eroded Leather Case to Thiah Redmane, camped near the Ruins of Sha'naar in western Hellfire Peninsula.
english.description: Upon examining the battered leather case, it becomes apparent that the container's damage must've been caused by the caustic fluid of the worm's digestive tract. The leather appears to have been intricately tooled at one time, but the details of its adornment can no longer be made out.$B$BThe only recognizable feature of the case is a worn logo of the Cenarion Circle. Knowing nothing about the contents of the case, you decide the best course of action would be to deliver it to a Circle member.
english.progress: Good day, $c. What brings you to my encampment?
english.completion: Thank you for bringing this to me, $c. I was wondering why I hadn't heard from the Expedition in so long. I wonder how long ago this message was dispatched and what befell its carrier. Here's a bit of coin for your trouble.

text.title: 埃雷利恩的日记
text.objectives: 地狱火半岛猎鹰岗哨的魔导师卡尔琳达要你前往阿苟纳之池，找回埃雷利恩的日记。
text.description: 来到外域后，我的丈夫埃雷利恩便对阿苟纳之池着了迷。他耗费大量的时间去那儿研究软泥怪！$B$B几天前，他突然失踪了。他们都说他已经死了，劝我放弃一切希望。$B$B我唯一能做的就是找回他的研究笔记。前往阿苟纳之池的东北方寻找他的日记，他总是把它放在那个褐色的背包中。
text.progress: Any luck, $n?  You'll find the Pools of Aggonar north of Hellfire Citadel.
text.completion: My husband's journal... it's not about research at all! How could I've been such a fool?  "Magical properties of fel-infused slime forms," he really had me going there.
text.completed: Return to Magistrix Carinda at Falcon Watch in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Arelion's Journal
english.objectives: Magistrix Carinda at Falcon Watch in Hellfire Peninsula wants you to go to the Pools of Aggonar and retrieve Arelion's Journal.
english.description: My husband, Arelion, had been fascinated with the Pools of Aggonar ever since we arrived in Outland.  He spent much of his time studying slimes, of all things!$B$BHe went missing in there a few days ago.  They say he's dead and there's nothing I can do about it.$B$BOne thing I can do is try to ensure that his research doesn't die with him.  Go northeast to the pools and look for his journal.  He always carried it inside a brown knapsack.
english.progress: Any luck, $n?  You'll find the Pools of Aggonar north of Hellfire Citadel.
english.completion: My husband's journal... it's not about research at all! How could I've been such a fool?  "Magical properties of fel-infused slime forms," he really had me going there.
english.completed: Return to Magistrix Carinda at Falcon Watch in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 猎鹰岗哨之路
text.objectives: 护送受伤的血精灵朝圣者返回猎鹰岗哨，然后与塔雷里斯·晨光谈一谈。
text.description: <这个受尽折磨的血精灵看到你之后，脸上的痛苦表情显得平缓了许多。>$B$B$C，请你一定把我救出去。唉……我太愚蠢了，没有听从玛提克·托塞多雷的警告，一意孤行离开了萨尔玛。结果，我在路上遭到了那些可怕怪物的袭击，是的，没错，就是玛提克·托塞多雷提到过的掠食者。我好不容易击退了它们，可没想到竟然遇到了更大的麻烦。$B$B在我包扎伤口的时候，那些鸟人发现了我，并把我抓来这个洞穴，锁进了这只笼子里！我必须出去，我必须到猎鹰岗哨去！
text.progress: 你需要什麽，$C?
text.completion: Get her inside and see to her wounds! She's fortunate that you found her when you did, $c. I don't think she'd have lasted much longer out there. Can you make out what she was saying?
text.end: Escort Wounded Blood Elf Pilgrim to Falcon Watch
text.completed: Speak with Taleris Dawngazer at Falcon Watch in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: The Road to Falcon Watch
english.objectives: Protect the Wounded Blood Elf Pilgrim on her way to Falcon Watch, then speak with Taleris Dawngazer.
english.description: <The battered blood elf's face displays relief at your presence.>$B$BPlease, $c, get me out of this cage! I foolishly set out from Thrallmar ahead of the main group, despite Martik Tor'seldori's warnings.$B$BI was set upon by horrible creatures that could only be the ravagers he talked about. I managed to drive them off, but that was only the beginning of my troubles.$B$BAs I bound my wounds, those bird men found me, dragged me back to this cave, and locked me in this cage! I must get to Falcon Watch!
english.completion: Get her inside and see to her wounds! She's fortunate that you found her when you did, $c. I don't think she'd have lasted much longer out there. Can you make out what she was saying?
english.end: Escort Wounded Blood Elf Pilgrim to Falcon Watch
english.completed: Speak with Taleris Dawngazer at Falcon Watch in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 朝圣者的困境
text.objectives: 受伤的血精灵朝圣者在尘羽峡谷宿营时遭到了钢牙掠食者的袭击。前往那处营地寻找丢失的背包。
text.description: 这名受伤的朝圣者在昏迷中似乎一直在说着什么，好象有提到什么背包的样子。$B$B那么，你遇到她的时候，在附近看到过她的背包吗？$B$B嗯……她一定是在逃走的时候把它弄丢了。南边峡谷的钢牙掠食者常常会袭击单身的旅行者。$B$B如果她不能平静下来的话，我是没有办法为她疗伤的，唉，她的倔强会要了她的命……$B$B去尘羽峡谷看看能否找到她的营地吧，或许她把背包遗留在那里了。
text.progress: Things aren't going well. At this rate, she'll never make it back onto the road. Were you able to find that pack?
text.completion: Thank you for returning this, $n. I'm not sure what significance it holds for the wounded pilgrim, but she refuses to let anyone get near her until it's in her hands again.
text.completed: Return to Taleris Dawngazer at Falcon Watch in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: A Pilgrim's Plight
english.objectives: The Wounded Blood Elf Pilgrim was attacked by Quillfang Ravagers while camped in Dustquill Ravine. Find her camp and search it for the missing pack.
english.description: That wounded pilgrim seems to be shouting something about a pack.$B$BWhen you encountered her, did you see a pack nearby? Hmm...$B$BShe must've left it when fleeing from her attackers. The quillfang ravagers, in their ravine to the south, are known to attack solitary travelers.$B$BIf she doesn't calm down, I won't be able to tend her wounds. Her stubbornness may just cost her her life.$B$BGo to Dustquill Ravine and see if you can find her campsite. I'm willing to bet she left it there.
english.progress: Things aren't going well. At this rate, she'll never make it back onto the road. Were you able to find that pack?
english.completion: Thank you for returning this, $n. I'm not sure what significance it holds for the wounded pilgrim, but she refuses to let anyone get near her until it's in her hands again.
english.completed: Return to Taleris Dawngazer at Falcon Watch in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: Thirsting For Power
text.objectives: Retrieve a Potent Voidwalker Essence from the Vengeful Voidwalkers and return to Taleris Dawngazer at Falcon Watch.
text.description: Falcon Watch serves as a stop for pilgrims on their long journey into Outland. Although we are an early stop on the way, many of the pilgrims reach us exhausted and wracked by their addictions.$B$BIn a world such as this, many find it necessary to relearn mastery of their magical addiction. Food and drink help, $c, but magical energy is their greatest need. The remains of Outland's voidwalkers provide a potent source of energy, but they grow rare and can only be found in the Warp Fields to the southwest.
text.completed: Return to Taleris Dawngazer at Falcon Watch in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: DND FLAG可怕的堡垒 - 纳克萨玛斯
text.objectives: 东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的大法师安琪拉·多桑杜将免费给你秘法掩护。你一定要在银色黎明达到崇拜声望。
text.description: 在浓密的病木林里有个入口通往纳克萨玛斯的可怕堡垒。以前，任何想尝试进入的人都被符文传送门外的魔法守卫挡下来。直到现在。$B$B我们设计了一个方法，透过一个永久的秘法掩护 - 肯瑞托的古老咒语加上一些我自己做的修改。说到这，那个斗篷是要钱的；不过，你对银色黎明的贡献不可动摇!我们会取消所有的费用。

english.title: DND FLAG The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
english.objectives: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will grant you Arcane Cloaking at no cost. You must be Exalted with the Argent Dawn.
english.description: In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of Naxxramas. Previously, all attempts to enter had been stymied by the magical wards placed upon the rune portal. That is, until now.$B$BWe have devised a way to gain entry via a permanent arcane cloaking of sorts - an old cantrip of the Kirin Tor with a few modifications of my own. With that said, the cloaking is costly; however, your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is unwavering! We will waive all cost associations.

text.title: Fortifying the Felhunter
text.objectives: Gather 6 Warp Hound Blood and bring them to Angela "The Claw" Kestrel in Thrallmar.
text.description: Greetings, $c. Say hello to Jir'see here, too. Don't worry, he won't bite unless I tell him to.$B$B<Angela makes a cooing sound at the felhunter.>$B$BHe's so tiny in comparison to the warp hounds that live in Outland. But we're going to fix that right up, yes we are, aren't we, Jir'see?$B$BI think I've figured out a way to do it. I'll need plenty of blood from the warp hounds and that's where you come in. While you're hunting them in the southeast, I'll get ready for the experi... err, treatment.
text.completed: Return to Angela "The Claw" Kestrel in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.objectives: Gather 6 Warp Hound Blood and bring them to Angela "The Claw" Kestrel in Thrallmar.
