english.objectives: Lord Solanar Bloodwrath in Silvermoon City wants you to destroy 3 Scourge Meat Wagons and kill 15 Scourge Siege Engineers.
english.description: We Blood Knights are bound to defend Quel'Thalas, $N. This is a central part of your training. Our enemies are fierce and unrelenting. Silvermoon and its people remain free by our efforts and the support of our allies.$B$BI have received some disturbing reports of a renewed Scourge presence to the southeast of our border with the Eastern Plaguelands. A company of Scourge siege engineers and their equipment appear to be staging for an attack on the Ghostlands. They must not be permitted to succeed.
english.completed: Return to Lord Solanar Bloodwrath in Silvermoon City.

text.title: 既然我们是朋友……
text.objectives: 杀掉12个血鳞驱奴者和6个血鳞女巫，然后向赞加沼泽孢子村的舒特复命。
text.description: 东北边血鳞领地的纳迦正在追杀我们的人民。我们绝对不容许这样的事情继续发生，$C！$B$B希望你能去给他们点颜色瞧瞧，同时也可以证明我们之间的友谊。
text.completion: We are pleased that you have affirmed our friendship, $n.  Perhaps the naga heathens will think twice about harassing us in the future now that we have such a powerful ally?
text.completed: Return to Gzhun'tt at Sporeggar in Zangarmarsh.

english.title: Now That We're Friends...
english.objectives: Kill 12 Bloodscale Slavedrivers and 6 Bloodscale Enchantresses, and then return to Gzhun'tt at Sporeggar in Zangarmarsh.
english.description: The naga of the Bloodscale Enclave to the northeast have begun to kill our people.  We cannot allow this to continue, $c!$B$BWe suggest that you teach them a lesson as proof of our friendship.
english.completion: We are pleased that you have affirmed our friendship, $n.  Perhaps the naga heathens will think twice about harassing us in the future now that we have such a powerful ally?
english.completed: Return to Gzhun'tt at Sporeggar in Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 既然我们仍是朋友……
text.objectives: 杀掉12个血鳞驱奴者和6个血鳞女巫，然后向赞加沼泽孢子村的舒特复命。
text.description: 有报告说东北边血鳞领地的纳迦还在继续追杀我们的人民。我们觉得你有经验去解决这件事，$C！$B$B我想委托你去好好教训教训他们，作为我们友谊延续的证明。
text.completion: We are pleased that you have reaffirmed our friendship, $n.  Surely now that you have made our point clear multiple times, their senseless attacks upon our people will cease?
text.completed: Return to Gzhun'tt at Sporeggar in Zangarmarsh.

english.title: Now That We're Still Friends...
english.objectives: Kill 12 Bloodscale Slavedrivers and 6 Bloodscale Enchantresses, and then return to Gzhun'tt at Sporeggar in Zangarmarsh.
english.description: Reports have come in that the naga of the Bloodscale Enclave to the northeast continue to kill our people.  We thought that you had dealt with this, $c!$B$BI suggest that you to teach them a lesson as proof of our continued friendship.
english.completion: We are pleased that you have reaffirmed our friendship, $n.  Surely now that you have made our point clear multiple times, their senseless attacks upon our people will cease?
english.completed: Return to Gzhun'tt at Sporeggar in Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 热情的欢迎
text.objectives: 将30个纳迦爪子交给塞纳里奥庇护所的监护者哈穆特。
text.description: 在塞纳里奥远征队的德鲁伊们忙于研究植被和勘测湖泊时，我承担起了保卫庇护所的重责。$B$B自打我们来到赞加沼泽，纳迦就在毫无征兆的情况下多次对我们发动突袭。我们已经尽力牵制他们的攻势，可惜毕竟人手有限。$B$B我想让你前往纳迦在赞加沼泽的各个据点，让他们明白我们不是好惹的。把纳迦的爪子带回来给我，作为你击杀他们的证据。
text.progress: It's good to see you again, $n.  How's your hunt for the naga going?
text.completion: Good job, $n.  You'd do well to shed any feelings of remorse you might harbor.  These naga are vicious creatures - even more so than the Azerothian ones.
text.completed: Return to Warden Hamoot at Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.

english.title: A Warm Welcome
english.objectives: Warden Hamoot at the Cenarion Refuge wants you to bring him 30 Naga Claws.
english.description: While the druids from the expedition have made themselves busy studying plants and researching the lakes, I've made it my business to deal with the hostiles in the area.$B$BEver since we set foot in Zangarmarsh, the naga have launched lethal attacks against us without warning.  We've done our best to keep them at bay, but our resources are limited.$B$BI want you to go to the various naga strongholds in Zangarmarsh and show them that we're not to be crossed.  Bring me their claws as proof of your victories.
english.progress: It's good to see you again, $n.  How's your hunt for the naga going?
english.completion: Good job, $n.  You'd do well to shed any feelings of remorse you might harbor.  These naga are vicious creatures - even more so than the Azerothian ones.
english.completed: Return to Warden Hamoot at Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 弗沃尔发怒了！
text.objectives: 护送弗沃尔进入沼光湖水域，在蒸汽泵处找回萨斯里斯圣柜，保护弗沃尔携带圣柜安然返回，然后向赞加沼泽孢子村的舒特复命。
text.description: Little naga make Fhwoor angry!  Sporelings good friend to Fhwoor, so Fhwoor get naga ark.$B$BWe go into nearby naga village.  You help?  Bring friends!
text.completion: Fhwoor's a good giant.  We saved him from the naga a while ago and he's stayed here helping us with things ever since. We can only hope that the naga will take the hint and realize that if we can infiltrate their village and steal their most prized possession, we can do much worse.  Perhaps now they will return to their reservoir and leave us in peace?
text.end: Ark of Ssslith safely returned to Sporeggar
text.completed: Return to Gzhun'tt at Sporeggar in Zangarmarsh.

english.title: Fhwoor Smash!
english.objectives: Escort Fhwoor into the area of the Marshlight steam pump to retrieve the Ark of Ssslith.  Bring Fhwoor and the ark back safely and then report back to Gzhun'tt at Sporeggar in Zangarmarsh.
english.description: Little naga make Fhwoor angry!  Sporelings good friend to Fhwoor, so Fhwoor get naga ark.$B$BWe go into nearby naga village.  You help?  Bring friends!
english.completion: Fhwoor's a good giant.  We saved him from the naga a while ago and he's stayed here helping us with things ever since. We can only hope that the naga will take the hint and realize that if we can infiltrate their village and steal their most prized possession, we can do much worse.  Perhaps now they will return to their reservoir and leave us in peace?
english.end: Ark of Ssslith safely returned to Sporeggar
english.completed: Return to Gzhun'tt at Sporeggar in Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 暗潮纳迦的首领
text.objectives: Slay Rajah Haghazed at the Lagoon and return to Warden Hamoot at the Cenarion Expedition in Zangarmarsh for a reward.
text.description: 塞纳里奥远征队重金悬赏击杀暗潮纳迦首领——哈格哈兹王子的勇士。塞纳里奥斥候最后一次发现哈格哈兹是在赞加沼泽中南部的环礁湖。$B$B暗潮纳迦曾多次袭击塞纳里奥远征队，他们的首领被视为极度危险的人物。$B$B诛杀哈格哈兹王子的勇士可在监护者哈穆特处领取奖赏。
text.completion: I didn't like the naga in Azeroth and I like them less here.  It's a real shame our mission could not remain a peaceful one, but you won't see me shedding tears for dead naga. Here's your reward for taking care of the Darkcrest leader, $n.
text.completed: Return to Warden Hamoot at Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.

english.title: Leader of the Darkcrest
english.objectives: Slay Rajah Haghazed at the Lagoon and return to Warden Hamoot at the Cenarion Expedition in Zangarmarsh for a reward.
english.description: A bounty is hereby declared by the Cenarion Expedition on Rajah Haghazed, leader of the Darkcrest naga.  Haghazed was last sighted by Cenarion scouts at the Lagoon, in the central southern region of Zangarmarsh.$B$BThe Darkcrest have been linked to numerous attacks against the Cenarion Expedition and their leader is considered extremely dangerous.$B$BThose seeking to claim the bounty are advised to report to Warden Hamoot.
english.completion: I didn't like the naga in Azeroth and I like them less here.  It's a real shame our mission could not remain a peaceful one, but you won't see me shedding tears for dead naga. Here's your reward for taking care of the Darkcrest leader, $n.
english.completed: Return to Warden Hamoot at Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 抽水泵结构图
text.objectives: Search Serpent Lake for signs of a drain.  Return to Ysiel Windsinger at the Cenarion Refuge with news of your discovery.
text.description: 这张结构图上绘制着连接毒蛇湖和邻近湖泊的地下排水系统。$B$B如果图表属实的话，那么毒蛇湖的中心必定有一台巨大的抽水泵。核实这个消息是否属实，然后返回塞纳里奥庇护所复命。
text.progress: What news do you bring, $n?
text.completion: The naga have turned Serpent Lake into a giant water sink for the rest of Zangarmarsh.  What could they possibly be doing? You've done well in bringing this news to us, $n.  We will send a team to investigate this drain you've discovered.  I have a different task for you in the meanwhile.
text.completed: 返回赞加沼泽的塞纳里奥庇护所，向伊谢尔·风歌复命。

english.title: Drain Schematics
english.objectives: Search Serpent Lake for signs of a drain.  Return to Ysiel Windsinger at the Cenarion Refuge with news of your discovery.
english.description: The schematics you've obtained show an underground system of drains and pumps that connect the lakes in the region to Serpent Lake.$B$BIf the schematics are correct, there is a giant drain in the center of Serpent Lake.  Confirm this and bring the news to Cenarion Refuge.
english.progress: What news do you bring, $n?
english.completion: The naga have turned Serpent Lake into a giant water sink for the rest of Zangarmarsh.  What could they possibly be doing? You've done well in bringing this news to us, $n.  We will send a team to investigate this drain you've discovered.  I have a different task for you in the meanwhile.
english.completed: Return to Ysiel Windsinger at the Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 返回沼泽
text.objectives: 返回赞加沼泽的塞纳里奥庇护所，向伊谢尔·风歌复命。
text.description: 回到Ysiel，让她知道尽快给她帮助。$B$B Moonglade和Silithus的楼主让我们的会员占用了，但是我们会尽我们所能必要的资源塞纳里奥避难所。
text.completion: You are a welcome sight, $n.  Matters at the Cenarion Refuge have only gotten worse since you left.

english.title: Return to the Marsh
english.objectives: Return to Ysiel Windsinger at the Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.
english.description: Return to Ysiel and let her know that help will be extended to her as soon as it is possible.$B$BAffairs in Moonglade and Silithus have kept our members occupied, but we will do our best to send the necessary resources to the Cenarion Refuge.
english.completion: You are a welcome sight, $n.  Matters at the Cenarion Refuge have only gotten worse since you left.

text.title: 通知塞纳里奥议会
text.objectives: Speak to Mahuram Stouthoof at Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula.
text.description: 塞纳里奥远征队已经成为了一个强大且独立的组织。这件事情非常重要，我们必须提醒塞纳里奥议会。$B$B用不着担心，我不会让你回月光林地的。在地狱火半岛上就有我们的信使。

english.title: Warning the Cenarion Circle
english.objectives: Speak to Mahuram Stouthoof at Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula.
english.description: The Cenarion Expedition has become a large organization with a good degree of autonomy.  These events are important enough that we need to warn the Cenarion Circle.$B$BDo not worry, I will not ask you to travel back to Moonglade; we have emissaries as nearby as Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 返回沼泽
text.objectives: 返回赞加沼泽的塞纳里奥庇护所，向伊谢尔·风歌复命。
text.description: 回到Ysiel，让她知道尽快给她帮助。$B$B Moonglade和Silithus的楼主让我们的会员占用了，但是我们会尽我们所能必要的资源塞纳里奥避难所。

english.title: Return to the Marsh
english.objectives: Return to Ysiel Windsinger at the Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.
english.description: Return to Ysiel and let her know that help will be extended to her as soon as it is possible.$B$BAffairs in Moonglade and Silithus have kept our members occupied, but we will do our best to send the necessary resources to the Cenarion Refuge.

text.title: 圣光的主人
text.objectives: Lord Solanar Bloodwrath in Silvermoon City wants you to bring him a vial of Tyr's Hand Holy Water.
text.description: A Blood Knight master possesses incredible skill at wielding and weaving the Light in a way that other so-called 'paladins' can never comprehend. It doesn't stop them from despising us for unleashing the Light's true potential.$B$BWe must send them a message and show them that we are not to be trifled with. What I have in mind will be neither brief nor easy, but if you are committed, the first step will be to infiltrate the library wing of the Tyr's Hand Abbey and procure a vial of Tyr's Hand holy water.
text.completed: Return to Lord Solanar Bloodwrath in Silvermoon City.

english.title: True Masters of the Light
english.objectives: Lord Solanar Bloodwrath in Silvermoon City wants you to bring him a vial of Tyr's Hand Holy Water.
english.description: A Blood Knight master possesses incredible skill at wielding and weaving the Light in a way that other so-called 'paladins' can never comprehend. It doesn't stop them from despising us for unleashing the Light's true potential.$B$BWe must send them a message and show them that we are not to be trifled with. What I have in mind will be neither brief nor easy, but if you are committed, the first step will be to infiltrate the library wing of the Tyr's Hand Abbey and procure a vial of Tyr's Hand holy water.
english.completed: Return to Lord Solanar Bloodwrath in Silvermoon City.

text.title: 圣光的主人
text.objectives: Lord Solanar Bloodwrath in Silvermoon City wants you to bring him 1 Arcane Catalyst, 1 Crepuscular Powder, 1 Azerothian Diamond, and 1 Pristine Black Diamond.
text.description: Now that we have the water, we're going to need a number of reagents in precise quantities. Some of these substances are rare and expensive, $N, but I have located sources for two.$B$BYou should be able to purchase some arcane catalyst from Zalle, the reagent vendor in one of the shops on the plaza near the Dead Scar. Darlia, the poison merchant near the rogue trainers on Murder Row, stocks crepuscular powder.$B$BTo complete my mixture, I'll also need an azerothian diamond and a pristine black diamond.
text.completed: Return to Lord Solanar Bloodwrath in Silvermoon City.

english.title: True Masters of the Light
english.objectives: Lord Solanar Bloodwrath in Silvermoon City wants you to bring him 1 Arcane Catalyst, 1 Crepuscular Powder, 1 Azerothian Diamond, and 1 Pristine Black Diamond.
english.description: Now that we have the water, we're going to need a number of reagents in precise quantities. Some of these substances are rare and expensive, $N, but I have located sources for two.$B$BYou should be able to purchase some arcane catalyst from Zalle, the reagent vendor in one of the shops on the plaza near the Dead Scar. Darlia, the poison merchant near the rogue trainers on Murder Row, stocks crepuscular powder.$B$BTo complete my mixture, I'll also need an azerothian diamond and a pristine black diamond.
english.completed: Return to Lord Solanar Bloodwrath in Silvermoon City.

text.title: 圣光的主人
text.objectives: Use the Extinguishing Mixture near the eternal flame in the Alonsus Chapel to remove the Light's protection. Be prepared to fight anyone who may attempt to defend the chapel.
text.description: Ours is the true way of utilizing the Light, $N. To show others that would call themselves 'paladins' the folly of their ways, I intend to send an unmistakable message.$B$BThe Alonsus Chapel, where the Order of the Silver Hand was founded, seems immune to the destruction of Stratholme. The chapel's eternal flame affords it the Light's protection, but when you use this mixture to extinguish the flame, that protection will be no more. It will burn, and our dominion over the Light will be proven to the world.
text.completed: Return to Lord Solanar Bloodwrath in Silvermoon City.

english.title: True Masters of the Light
english.objectives: Use the Extinguishing Mixture near the eternal flame in the Alonsus Chapel to remove the Light's protection. Be prepared to fight anyone who may attempt to defend the chapel.
english.description: Ours is the true way of utilizing the Light, $N. To show others that would call themselves 'paladins' the folly of their ways, I intend to send an unmistakable message.$B$BThe Alonsus Chapel, where the Order of the Silver Hand was founded, seems immune to the destruction of Stratholme. The chapel's eternal flame affords it the Light's protection, but when you use this mixture to extinguish the flame, that protection will be no more. It will burn, and our dominion over the Light will be proven to the world.
english.completed: Return to Lord Solanar Bloodwrath in Silvermoon City.

text.title: 失踪的同伴
text.objectives: 查明缚地者雷葛、博学者拜特、除草者格林萨姆和唤风者克劳恩的下落，然后返回赞加沼泽的盘牙水库，向观察者杰哈恩复命。
text.description: 你必须帮助我！伊谢尔派我们来这里调查神秘的蒸汽泵事件，以及纳迦为什么要利用蒸汽泵排出沼泽地的水。但是我的几位同伴闹了别扭，竟然撇下我独自行动。$B$B那四个家伙有时候脾气是挺古怪，不过我还是很喜欢他们的。$B$B我要你查明他们到底出了什么状况，我很担心他们遭遇不测。去奴隶围栏和幽暗沼泽看看吧。$B$B谢谢你，$C。
text.completion: I'm glad that some of my friends yet live, but it breaks my heart to hear of the fate of others.   At least they died doing what they loved most in life.  You have my eternal gratitude for helping me with this, $n. Please, take one of these as a sign of gratitude.
text.completed: Return to Watcher Jhang at Serpent Lake in Zangarmarsh.

english.title: Lost in Action
english.objectives: Discover what happened to Earthbinder Rayge, Naturalist Bite, Weeder Greenthumb, and Windcaller Claw.  Then, return to Watcher Jhang at Coilfang Reservoir in Zangarmarsh.
english.description: You have to help me!  We were sent here by Ysiel to investigate the mystery of the steam pumps and why they're being used to drain the water from the marsh.  But my friends split up and went on recklessly without me.$B$BThose four can be such jerks sometimes, but I love them anyway.$B$BThat is why I need you to discover what became of them, though I fear the worst.  Seek them in both the Slave Pens and the Underbog.$B$BThank you, $c.
english.completion: I'm glad that some of my friends yet live, but it breaks my heart to hear of the fate of others.   At least they died doing what they loved most in life.  You have my eternal gratitude for helping me with this, $n. Please, take one of these as a sign of gratitude.
english.completed: Return to Watcher Jhang at Serpent Lake in Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 孢子人的困境
text.objectives: 孢殖林的法恩森要你收集10个成熟的孢子囊。
text.description: 喂，叫你呢！你必须帮助我们！$B$B真菌巨人正在吞食孢子囊！必须想点什么办法，不然我们的孩子就都没命了！$B$B孢子囊刚刚开始生长的时候体积较大，随着囊内空气的消耗会逐渐缩小。寻找那些体积较小的成熟的孢子囊，尽你所能地拯救它们！
text.progress: The spore sacs!  Did you get them?
text.completion: You've done it!  You have my people's thanks. I hope you understand... this is where our young ones come from.  We can't let these beasts devour the sacs!
text.completed: Return to Fahssn at the Spawning Glen in Zangarmarsh.

english.title: The Sporelings' Plight
english.objectives: Fahssn at the Spawning Glen wants you to collect 10 Mature Spore Sacs.
english.description: You there!  You must help us!$B$BThe fungal giants are devouring all of our spore sacs!  You must do something, or we'll lose our young!$B$BThe spore sacs start out large and become smaller as the air inside them is depleted.  Look for the small, mature spore sacs and save as many of them as you can!
english.progress: The spore sacs!  Did you get them?
english.completion: You've done it!  You have my people's thanks. I hope you understand... this is where our young ones come from.  We can't let these beasts devour the sacs!
english.completed: Return to Fahssn at the Spawning Glen in Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 太阳之门
text.objectives: 秘血岗哨的守备官伊索姆要你摧毁太阳之门。
text.description: 谢谢你，我们已经找到了太阳之门的位置。血精灵可随意移动传送门的位置，以此对付突发状况，所以上次让你空跑一趟也就不足为奇了。$B$B但是，可移动的传送门有许多弊端。太阳之门靠传送门控制器固定。如果我们卸下控制器，就可以摧毁传送门。太阳之门现在的位置在这里的西边，矢量感应器南面的区域。去找到它，摧毁它！
text.completion: Smashing! We've cut off their supply line. Now all that we need to do is finish them off!
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Aesom at Blood Watch in Bloodmyst Isle.

english.title: The Sun Gate
english.objectives: Vindicator Aesom at Blood Watch wants you to destroy the Sun Gate.
english.description: Thanks to you and the work you did, my scouts were able to find the sun gate. The elves keep the portal location mobile so that they can move it at a moment's notice. That's why the site you investigated was empty.$B$BThe strength of such a system is also its greatest weakness. The sun gate is stabilized by portal controllers. If we can take down the controllers, the portal will be ours to destroy. The current sun gate location can be found west of here, south of the Vector Coil. Find it and destroy it!
english.completion: Smashing! We've cut off their supply line. Now all that we need to do is finish them off!
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Aesom at Blood Watch in Bloodmyst Isle.

text.title: 虚空幼体
text.objectives: Kill 12 Void Critters and report to Vindicator Aesom at Blood Watch.$B$B
text.description: 数日前，伊索姆派我的人外出搜寻太阳之门。当然，我们找到了……$B$B<洛伊指着约莉。>$B$B愚蠢的血精灵在打开传送门的同时，释放了虚空的力量。现在这儿出现了成群的虚空幼体。$B$B我们必须在它们成长为虚空畸能之前杀掉它们。西南方的太阳之门附近聚集了大量这种生物。杀死它们，然后向伊索姆复命。
text.completion: It's a real mess up there, eh? You've done well, $n. I'll send some anchorites out to help Loryi and Jorli.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Aesom at Blood Watch in Bloodmyst Isle.

english.title: Critters of the Void
english.objectives: Kill 12 Void Critters and report to Vindicator Aesom at Blood Watch.$B$B
english.description: Aesom sent my squad out on a reconnaissance mission to search for the sun gate a few days ago. Needless to say, we found it...$B$B<Loryi points at Jorli.>$B$BWhatever those fool elves are transporting through that portal is causing void energy to be released. The area is teaming with void critters. $B$BWe must destroy them before they have a chance to grow into void anomalies. You'll find the source of the creatures southwest of here, near the sun gate. Kill them and report back to Aesom when you're done.
english.completion: It's a real mess up there, eh? You've done well, $n. I'll send some anchorites out to help Loryi and Jorli.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Aesom at Blood Watch in Bloodmyst Isle.

text.title: 更多孢子囊
text.progress: Have you rescued any more spore sacs, $r?
text.completion: Yes!  You've saved more spore sacs. You're different than the other outsiders.  I'll let my people know about your deeds!
text.completed: Return to Fahssn at the Spawning Glen in Zangarmarsh.

english.title: More Spore Sacs
english.progress: Have you rescued any more spore sacs, $r?
english.completion: Yes!  You've saved more spore sacs. You're different than the other outsiders.  I'll let my people know about your deeds!
english.completed: Return to Fahssn at the Spawning Glen in Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 天敌
text.objectives: 将6根沼泽领主的卷须交给赞加沼泽孢殖林的法恩森。
text.description: 孢子人与沼泽领主是世代的宿敌。过去，我们利用长矛和石块与之抗衡。近来他们似乎变得更具攻击性……并且更加不计后果。他们不再惧怕我们，也无视我们手中的武器。$B$B你的威慑力和装备都远胜于我们。如果你愿意替我们打败沼泽领主的话，孢子人会永远感激你的！把他们的卷须带回来给我，这样我就知道你确实在帮助我们了。
text.progress: How's the bog lord slaying going?  Teach those brutes not to come into sporeling territory!
text.completion: You made it back alive!  I'll let the other sporelings know about you!  $n, the giant slayer!
text.completed: Return to Fahssn at the Spawning Glen in Zangarmarsh.

english.title: Natural Enemies
english.objectives: Fahssn at the Spawning Glen in Zangarmarsh wants you to bring him 6 Bog Lord Tendrils.
english.description: Us sporelings and the bog lords have never gotten along well.  In the past, we've managed to keep them at bay with spears and stones.  Lately they seem to have become more aggressive... or more desperate.  They do not fear us or our weapons.$B$BYou are much scarier and better armed than us.  If you were to fight the boglords for us, we'd be forever in your debt!  Bring me their tendrils so I know how many you've killed.
english.progress: How's the bog lord slaying going?  Teach those brutes not to come into sporeling territory!
english.completion: You made it back alive!  I'll let the other sporelings know about you!  $n, the giant slayer!
english.completed: Return to Fahssn at the Spawning Glen in Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 更多卷须！
text.completion: Unbelievable!  It would take hundreds of sporelings to slay as many giants as you have.  I will make sure to let everyone know of your feats!
text.completed: Return to Fahssn at the Spawning Glen in Zangarmarsh.

english.title: More Tendrils!
english.completion: Unbelievable!  It would take hundreds of sporelings to slay as many giants as you have.  I will make sure to let everyone know of your feats!
english.completed: Return to Fahssn at the Spawning Glen in Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 精疲力尽
text.objectives: Vindicator Aesom at Blood Watch wants you to slay 10 Sunhawk Pyromancers and 10 Sunhawk Defenders.$B$B
text.description: $N，胜利在望。我们已经发现了太阳之门，很快就能彻底切断血精灵的补给线。首先，我们要削减他们的数量。$B$B此地以西有许多炎鹰部队营地。炎鹰火法师和炎鹰防御者是那里的主要防备力量。去杀死他们，然后向我复命。
text.completion: This will surely soften up their defenses and make them think twice before rushing foolishly into our ranks!
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Aesom at Blood Watch in Bloodmyst Isle.

english.title: Limits of Physical Exhaustion
english.objectives: Vindicator Aesom at Blood Watch wants you to slay 10 Sunhawk Pyromancers and 10 Sunhawk Defenders.$B$B
english.description: Victory is close at hand, $N. With the discovery of the sun gate, it won't be long until their supply lines are completely closed off. Now is the time to strike at their numbers.$B$BTo the west you will find numerous Sunhawk camps. The Sunhawk pyromancers and defenders occupy the vast majority of the area. Find them, kill them and return to me.
english.completion: This will surely soften up their defenses and make them think twice before rushing foolishly into our ranks!
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Aesom at Blood Watch in Bloodmyst Isle.

text.title: 暗泽部族
text.objectives: 塞纳里奥庇护所的伊卡因希望你前往暗泽村，杀死卡塔鲁、8个暗泽先知、6个暗泽巫医和6个暗泽神谕者。
text.description: 纳迦真是可憎的生物，但是暗地里帮助纳迦的破碎者和失落者更加令人厌恶！$B$B其中尤以暗泽失落者部族的行径最为恶劣，他们利用黑暗的魔法奴役其他人。暗泽失落者对企图逃跑的奴隶非常残忍，如果我离开庇护所，肯定会被他们干掉的。$B$B前往南边的暗泽村，杀死暗泽失落者和他们的首领卡塔鲁，否则我就要在惶惶不安中度过余生了。
text.completion: Thank you, $n.  I will finally sleep comfortably at night.  Were I not so old and weakened I would deal with my own enemies. Take this gold.  It is not much, but your kindness cannot go unpaid.
text.completed: Return to Ikeyen at the Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.

english.title: The Umbrafen Tribe
english.objectives: Ikeyen at the Cenarion Refuge wants you to travel to Umbrafen Village and slay Kataru, 8 Umbrafen Seers, 6 Umbrafen Witchdoctors and 6 Umbrafen Oracles.
english.description: The naga are terrible, yes.  But even more terrible are the traitor tribes of Broken and Lost Ones that helped them!$B$BThe worst of all are the Lost Ones of the Umbrafen tribe; they use dark magic to trap and enslave others. They're especially cruel to escaped slaves and would slit my throat if I left the refuge even for a day.$B$BTravel to Umbrafen Village south of here and kill them and their leader, Kataru.  Until then I will fear for my life every single day.
english.completion: Thank you, $n.  I will finally sleep comfortably at night.  Were I not so old and weakened I would deal with my own enemies. Take this gold.  It is not much, but your kindness cannot go unpaid.
english.completed: Return to Ikeyen at the Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 毒水
text.objectives: 用水样瓶取回一份秘血岛水样，然后向秘血岗哨的守备官伊索姆复命。
text.description: 据我们的萨满祭司说，由于水源受到污染，水元素变得躁动难安。我们知道西边的山脉中散落着埃索达的能量核心。一定是能量核心泄漏出的挥发性液体污染了水源！我要你去采集水样。$B$B<伊索姆指着一只小瓶，点了点头。>$B$B拿上这只小瓶，沿着河岸往北走，在秘血岛河流入海口附近取一份水样，然后把水样带回来给我。
text.progress: Don't drink the water, $n!
text.completion: As I suspected, the water has turned red due to contamination from leaking core fluid. I hope you didn't swim in any of that contaminated water.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Aesom at Blood Watch in Bloodmyst Isle.

english.title: Don't Drink the Water
english.objectives: Vindicator Aesom at Blood Watch wants you to use the Water Sample Flask to get a Bloodmyst Water Sample.
english.description: Our shaman claim that the elements of water have become greatly agitated by the pollution of the water source. We know that the Exodar's power core is lodged into the mountain to the west. It must be leaking volatile fluids into the water supply! I need you to get me more information.$B$B<Aesom points to a flask and nods.>$B$BYou are to take this flask and follow the beach north until you reach the area where the rivers of Bloodmyst drain into the ocean. Take a sample from that location and return to me.
english.progress: Don't drink the water, $n!
english.completion: As I suspected, the water has turned red due to contamination from leaking core fluid. I hope you didn't swim in any of that contaminated water.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Aesom at Blood Watch in Bloodmyst Isle.

text.title: 他们还活着！也许……
text.objectives: 研究员考内留斯要你救出5个远征队研究员。
text.description: It was a bloody mess, $N. We were ambushed by a large pack of these spiders. Their progenitor descended upon us with incredible speed and wrapped us up in cocoons.$B$BAfter we were webbed, she began to lay eggs near us. We were to be food for her young! FOOD!$B$BI managed to cut my way out and escape but I will not leave the others behind. So far I've been unsuccessful in nearing the pass. Would you lend a hand?$B$BDestroy those cocoons! Hopefully some of our team is still alive!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Researcher Cornelius at Amberweb Pass in Bloodmyst Isle.

english.title: They're Alive! Maybe...
english.objectives: Researcher Cornelius has asked that you free 5 Expedition Researchers.
english.description: It was a bloody mess, $N. We were ambushed by a large pack of these spiders. Their progenitor descended upon us with incredible speed and wrapped us up in cocoons.$B$BAfter we were webbed, she began to lay eggs near us. We were to be food for her young! FOOD!$B$BI managed to cut my way out and escape but I will not leave the others behind. So far I've been unsuccessful in nearing the pass. Would you lend a hand?$B$BDestroy those cocoons! Hopefully some of our team is still alive!$B$B
english.completed: Return to Researcher Cornelius at Amberweb Pass in Bloodmyst Isle.

text.title: 血咒的遗产
text.objectives: 海军上将奥德修斯要你找到艾德华·汉斯船长，然后与他谈一谈。
text.description: Last night, Edward Hanes, captain of the ship 'Lost Hope', appeared before me in my tent. The same Edward Hanes that died of scurvy 20 years ago.$B$BThis apparition told me a tale that made my heart tremble. A tale that I need you to hear and a mission that I need you to accomplish. Will you do it? Will you seek out Edward on Wyrmscar Island, northeast of Blood Watch?$B$B
text.completion: Have you heard of the bloodcurse, landlubber? No, of course you haven't. The bloodcurse is what sunk all these ships. The spoiled, desecrated part of the water here is known as Bloodcursed Reef - a part of the world you never want to visit. I've been here myself for 20 years. Scurvy my foot! I died on these wild shores as food for the dragons... Ah, but that's another story for another time. Right now, we have to help the poor souls that are trapped in that reef.

english.title: The Bloodcurse Legacy
english.objectives: Admiral Odesyus has asked that you find and speak with Captain Edward Hanes.
english.description: Last night, Edward Hanes, captain of the ship 'Lost Hope', appeared before me in my tent. The same Edward Hanes that died of scurvy 20 years ago.$B$BThis apparition told me a tale that made my heart tremble. A tale that I need you to hear and a mission that I need you to accomplish. Will you do it? Will you seek out Edward on Wyrmscar Island, northeast of Blood Watch?$B$B

The spoiled, desecrated part of the water here is known as Bloodcursed Reef - a part of the world you never want to visit. I've been here myself for 20 years. Scurvy my foot! I died on these wild shores as food for the dragons... Ah, but that's another story for another time. Right now, we have to help the poor souls that are trapped in that reef.

text.title: 逃离暗泽村
text.objectives: 护送凯拉·长鬃返回赞加沼泽的塞纳里奥庇护所，然后向伊谢尔·风歌复命。
text.description: 你必须帮助我逃离此地！$B$B我在附近采集草药时，这群野蛮人突然将我团团围住，企图绑架我。我奋力反抗，无奈他们人多势众。$B$B帮助我返回塞纳里奥庇护所，摆脱这帮渣滓和他们那邪恶魔法的控制！
text.completion: You rescued one of my druids.  We could never repay you, $n. You have my thanks as well as that of the expedition.
text.completed: 返回赞加沼泽的塞纳里奥庇护所，向伊谢尔·风歌复命。

english.title: Escape from Umbrafen
english.objectives: Escort Kayra Longmane to the Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.  Report to Ysiel Windsinger when you've completed this task.
english.description: You must help me get out of here!$B$BI was gathering herbs nearby when a handful of these little savages abducted me.  I tried to fight them off, but there were too many of them.$B$BHelp me return to the Cenarion Refuge and away from these cruel wretches and their vile magic!
english.completion: You rescued one of my druids.  We could never repay you, $n. You have my thanks as well as that of the expedition.
english.completed: Return to Ysiel Windsinger at the Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 我们所知道的……
text.objectives: 与秘血岗哨的主教埃德门图斯谈一谈。
text.description: 我们已经摸清了敌人的情况。血精灵的头目是个名叫希隆娜丝的恶魔，这家伙一直在密谋消灭我们。他们的最终目标是奴役沃洛斯，重新统治埃索达。$B$B赞美圣光，我们已经摧毁太阳之门，切断了他们的补给线。不幸的是，矢量感应器还在污染着大地，血精灵利用那些被放射性源污染的变异生物滋扰生事。$B$B埃德门图斯已经想出对付他们的法子了。去找他吧。
text.completion: I am in need of your services, $n. I have a plan to topple the entire Sunhawk army, but before we can progress, we need to gather some vital information. We need to identify the weaknesses in their primary defense. Unfortunately, we have been unable to get close enough to the Vector Coil to gauge their defenses. If we could get the prisoner to talk, we could get the information that we needed to break through the line and destroy the Vector Coil. You heard me, I want to blow the damned thing up.

english.title: What We Know...
english.objectives: Speak to Exarch Admetius at Blood Watch.
english.description: We've learned much of our enemies in recent days. The blood elves are led by a being known as Sironas and plot to destroy us. Ultimately, they seek to enslave O'ros and regain control of the Exodar.$B$BLight be praised, we have stopped their supply line by destroying the sun gate. Unfortunately, they continue to use the contaminant of the Vector Coil to poison the land, using the mutagenic properties of the fallout to their advantage.$B$BWith this knowledge, Admetius has devised a plan. Seek him out.
english.completion: I am in need of your services, $n. I have a plan to topple the entire Sunhawk army, but before we can progress, we need to gather some vital information. We need to identify the weaknesses in their primary defense. Unfortunately, we have been unable to get close enough to the Vector Coil to gauge their defenses. If we could get the prisoner to talk, we could get the information that we needed to break through the line and destroy the Vector Coil. You heard me, I want to blow the damned thing up.

text.title: 我们不知道的……
text.objectives: 与秘血岗哨的被抓住的炎鹰间谍交谈，了解炎鹰的相关信息。完成任务后向主教埃德门图斯复命。
text.description: Our attempts at interrogation have failed miserably, $N. Torture is - of course - out of the question. What we need is a draenei on the inside.$B$BI can cast a spell upon you that would make you appear blood elf and adjust your language. Through subterfuge, we may be able to get the information we need out of the captured agent.$B$BUnder this guise, I want you to get whatever information you can out of the prisoner.$B$BAnd $N, do not leave Blood Watch while disguised as the spell will fail.
text.completion: A-ha! Well done, $n. Well done, indeed. Are you ready to eradicate the blood elf menace from our island forever?
text.completed: Return to Exarch Admetius in Bloodmyst Isle.

english.title: What We Don't Know...
english.objectives: Speak to a Captured Sunhawk Agent at Blood Watch and recover Sunhawk Information. Return to Exarch Admetius when the task is complete.
english.description: Our attempts at interrogation have failed miserably, $N. Torture is - of course - out of the question. What we need is a draenei on the inside.$B$BI can cast a spell upon you that would make you appear blood elf and adjust your language. Through subterfuge, we may be able to get the information we need out of the captured agent.$B$BUnder this guise, I want you to get whatever information you can out of the prisoner.$B$BAnd $N, do not leave Blood Watch while disguised as the spell will fail.
english.completion: A-ha! Well done, $n. Well done, indeed. Are you ready to eradicate the blood elf menace from our island forever?
english.completed: Return to Exarch Admetius in Bloodmyst Isle.

text.title: Seek Huntress Kella Nightbow
text.objectives: Speak with Huntress Kella Nightbow near Valaar's Berth.
text.description: Huntress Kella Nightbow seeks the audience of all eligible hunters.  She is the one to teach you the skill of taming wild beasts, a lesson you should learn above all else at this point in your training.$b$bKella can be found near Valaar's Berth, the docks west of the Exodar.

english.title: Seek Huntress Kella Nightbow
english.objectives: Speak with Huntress Kella Nightbow near Valaar's Berth.
english.description: Huntress Kella Nightbow seeks the audience of all eligible hunters.  She is the one to teach you the skill of taming wild beasts, a lesson you should learn above all else at this point in your training.$b$bKella can be found near Valaar's Berth, the docks west of the Exodar.

text.title: 返回奥术师范迪瑞尔身边
text.objectives: 返回幽魂之地的塔奎林，与奥术师范迪瑞尔谈一谈。
text.description: 我的朋友，如果你能返回奥术师范迪瑞尔那儿就再好不过了。这是你第一次来幽魂之地执行任务，他一定非常关注你的情况。$B$B$N，我们对你寄予厚望，可别让我们失望。
text.completion: Oh good, there you are!  And just in time... there is much to be done!

english.title: Return to Arcanist Vandril
english.objectives: Return to Arcanist Vandril at Tranquillien in the Ghostlands.
english.description: Now my friend, if you would be so kind as to return to Arcanist Vandril, I know that he is very anxious to send you out on your first mission here in the Ghostlands.$B$BWe're counting on you, $N.  Don't let us down.
english.completion: Oh good, there you are!  And just in time... there is much to be done!

text.title: 终结他们的世界
text.objectives: 在爆破专家莱戈苏尝试摧毁矢量感应器的过程中保护他，并杀死希隆娜丝。完成任务后向秘血岗哨的主教埃德门图斯复命。
text.description: 如果你还珍稀自己的性命的话，就别接受这项任务。你瞧见远处山腰中巨大的能量核心了吗？一旦接下这项艰巨的任务，你就必须杀出一条血路，消灭所有阻拦我们去路的炎鹰血精灵。另外，你还要在我破坏矢量感应器的同时保护我，希隆娜丝就在那附近。$B$B$N，如果你不愿意接受任务，我也不会因此看扁你。$B$B但是，或许你正是破坏矢量感应器、杀死希隆娜丝的最佳人选。那么，你怎么说？
text.completion: You have saved the whole of Bloodmyst and Azuremyst, securing the $r way of life on Azeroth, $n! For this, there can be no amount of thanks, no reward, nothing large enough in scope to truly express our appreciation. Yet, there are still so many that were left behind on Draenor who cannot be here for this historic event. You must find your way back. Find your way back to the Outland, Hero of Argus. Bring our people home. Home to the land that you saved. Home to Azeroth...
text.end: Vector Coil Destroyed and Sironas Slain
text.completed: Return to Exarch Admetius in Bloodmyst Isle.

english.title: Ending Their World
english.objectives: Follow and protect Demolitionist Legoso as he attempts to destroy the Vector Coil and slay Sironas. Return to Exarch Admetius at Blood Watch should you complete the mission.
english.description: Don't accept this assignment if you value your life. You see that gigantic power core jutting out of the mountain side over yonder? Whoever takes on this burden will need to fight their way through that mountain, battling an army of Sunhawks while protecting me as I rig the core up for demolition. Sironas the eredar is somewhere up there as well.$B$BI won't think less of you if you just walk away, $N.$B$BBut maybe you're the one - the one to destroy the Vector Coil and take down Sironas. Well, are you?
english.completion: You have saved the whole of Bloodmyst and Azuremyst, securing the $r way of life on Azeroth, $n! For this, there can be no amount of thanks, no reward, nothing large enough in scope to truly express our appreciation. Yet, there are still so many that were left behind on Draenor who cannot be here for this historic event. You must find your way back. Find your way back to the Outland, Hero of Argus. Bring our people home. Home to the land that you saved. Home to Azeroth...
english.end: Vector Coil Destroyed and Sironas Slain
english.completed: Return to Exarch Admetius in Bloodmyst Isle.

text.title: 守备官营地
text.objectives: Speak with Vindicator Corin at Vindicator's Rest on Bloodmyst Isle.$B$B
text.description: I would not ask you to single-handedly bear the burden of destroying the Vector Coil and slaying Sironas, $N; however, I believe that you can be of some help in clearing the way for others that might take on such a dangerous assignment.$B$BTake the road going north out of Blood Watch and follow it until you get to the fork. Once there, take the left road and follow it until you see Vindicator's Rest - it will be slightly west of the road itself. Corin will be waiting for you.
text.completion: Perhaps you will be the one to deliver our people into a new age of prosperity and peace.

english.title: Vindicator's Rest
english.objectives: Speak with Vindicator Corin at Vindicator's Rest on Bloodmyst Isle.$B$B
english.description: I would not ask you to single-handedly bear the burden of destroying the Vector Coil and slaying Sironas, $N; however, I believe that you can be of some help in clearing the way for others that might take on such a dangerous assignment.$B$BTake the road going north out of Blood Watch and follow it until you get to the fork. Once there, take the left road and follow it until you see Vindicator's Rest - it will be slightly west of the road itself. Corin will be waiting for you.
english.completion: Perhaps you will be the one to deliver our people into a new age of prosperity and peace.

text.title: 清理道路
text.objectives: Vindicator Corin at Vindicator's Rest wants you to slay 8 Sunhawk Saboteurs and 8 Sunhawk Agents.$B$B
text.description: Only the most battle hardened, noble and positively fearless of draenei will submit to Legoso's mission. The exarch will not order any agent of the Hand to take on the task of destroying the Vector Coil and dispatching Sironas. He refuses to send any draenei to their death - which is what the mission is: suicide...$B$B<Corin sighs.>$B$BMy job is to soften up the Sunhawk defenses. You are to slay Sunhawks near the Vector Coil and keep the path clear for our champion - whoever that may be.
text.completion: Hopefully a hero arrives before they are able to call forth reinforcements to guard the area you just secured.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Corin at Vindicator's Rest in Bloodmyst Isle.
